CSI 300 jatuh 8.5% pada Oktober selepas rekod 12 minggu berturut-turut kerugian. Mulai 2 Nov PBOC melaksanakan repo berbalik semalaman harian pada 1.25%, dan Cailian melaporkan pengawal selia akan membincangkan sokongan pasaran saham, tanpa pengesahan rasmi.
summary.en: China's official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 in October from 50.1, back in contraction, and the non-manufacturing PMI slipped to 49.7, while the private RatingDog gauge held at 52.0. The CSI 300 fell 8.5% in October after a record 12 straight weekly losses. From Nov 2 the PBOC is running daily overnight reverse repos at 1.25%, and Cailian reported regulators would discuss stock support, with no official confirmation.

title.bm: Aktiviti kilang China menguncup semula dan saham memasuki pasaran menurun ketika PBOC beralih kepada kadar semalaman
title.en: China's factory activity shrinks again and stocks enter a bear market as the PBOC shifts toward an overnight rate

why.bm: China rakan dagang terbesar Malaysia, jadi permintaan yang lemah di sana memberi kesan kepada eksport, minyak sawit dan harga komoditi.
why.en: China is Malaysia's largest trading partner, so weaker demand there matters for exports, palm oil and commodity prices.

summary.bm: Washington telah menggugurkan beberapa tuntutan, termasuk kuasa veto AS terhadap perjanjian dagang Kanada dengan negara lain. Duti AS yang diugut akan menjejaskan hampir $28 bilion barangan Kanada, dan Perdana Menteri Mark Carney berkata isu utama masih belum selesai.
summary.en: Washington has dropped some demands, including a US veto over Canada's trade deals with other countries. Threatened US duties would affect nearly $28bn of Canadian goods, and Prime Minister Mark Carney says the main issues are still open.

title.bm: Trump kata perjanjian dagang dengan Kanada hampir tercapai, tetapi Carney kata isu utama belum selesai
title.en: Trump says a Canada trade deal is close, but Carney says key issues are unresolved

why.bm: Sejauh mana Washington berkompromi menunjukkan apa yang boleh dijangka rakan dagang lain, termasuk Malaysia, daripada Trump yang kini lebih lemah.
why.en: How far Washington bends here shows what other trade partners, Malaysia included, can expect from a weakened Trump.

summary.bm: Oscar Puente meletak jawatan enam hari selepas perlanggaran berhampiran Urda, kemalangan serius kedua dalam tempoh setahun, dan menarik diri daripada senarai calon pilihan raya umum awal Sepanyol pada 29 Nov. Laporan terdahulu menyatakan beliau enggan berundur walaupun berdepan protes.
summary.en: Oscar Puente resigned six days after the collision near Urda, the second serious accident within a year, and withdrew from candidate lists for Spain's Nov 29 early general election. Earlier reports said he had refused to go despite protests.

title.bm: Menteri pengangkutan Sepanyol letak jawatan selepas nahas kereta api laju meragut sekurang-kurangnya 69 nyawa
title.en: Spain's transport minister quits days after a high-speed rail crash killed at least 69

why.bm: Bencana kereta api besar kini mempengaruhi pilihan raya Eropah, dan ia peringatan tentang tuntutan keselamatan kereta api laju ketika Malaysia merancang projek relnya sendiri.
why.en: A major rail disaster is now reshaping a European election, and it is a reminder of what high-speed rail safety demands as Malaysia plans its own rail projects.

summary.bm: Trump memberitahu Fox News pada 4 Nov bahawa 'kita perlu buat sesuatu yang besar' dan 'serangan berat' mungkin berlaku, sambil memberitahu Financial Times beliau tiada rancangan segera menyerang; pegawai AS memberitahu Axios persiapan tempur besar sedang dimuktamadkan tetapi bukan arahan. Pengawal Revolusi Iran mendakwa empat kapal tangki terkena periuk api di selatan Hormuz dan sedang terbakar, dua kapal lain dihentikan, dakwaan yang tidak dapat disahkan secara bebas. Qatar menjadi pengantara draf perjanjian dengan urutan tiga hari langkah membina keyakinan, manakala Tehran menyifatkan jawapan AS 'tidak meyakinkan' dan menuntut sekatan laut ditamatkan, sekatan dilonggarkan dan dana beku dilepaskan sebelum membuka semula selat. Rumusan berasaskan Reuters kemudian menyebut Pengawal Revolusi merujuk dua kapal tangki dan sebuah bot tunda terbakar dalam insiden berasingan di 'laluan tanpa kebenaran', manakala Perbendaharaan AS mengenakan sekatan ke atas syarikat di India dan Turkiye yang membantu Iran menjual minyak.
summary.en: Trump told Fox News on Nov 4 that 'we have to do something large' and that a 'heavy hit' is possible, while telling the Financial Times he has no immediate plans to attack; US officials told Axios preparations for major combat are being finalised but are not an order. Iran's Revolutionary Guards say four tankers hit mines south of Hormuz and are burning, and two other vessels were halted, claims that could not be independently verified. Qatar is mediating a draft with a three-day sequence of confidence-building steps, and Tehran calls the US reply 'not convincing' and demands an end to the naval blockade, sanctions relief and frozen funds before reopening the strait. A later Reuters-based roundup says the Guards cited two tankers and a tugboat on fire in separate incidents on 'unauthorized routes', and the US Treasury sanctioned firms in India and Turkey for helping Iran sell oil.

title.bm: Trump bayangkan serangan 'besar' ke atas Iran ketika rundingan pengantaraan Qatar berterusan dan empat kapal tangki terbakar berhampiran Hormuz
title.en: Trump hints at a 'large' strike on Iran as Qatar-mediated talks run on and four tankers burn near Hormuz

why.bm: Hormuz menentukan kos minyak, bahan api dan perkapalan; serangan besar atau perjanjian boleh menggerakkan harga pam di Malaysia dan Brent dalam beberapa jam.
why.en: Hormuz drives oil, fuel and shipping costs, so a major strike or a deal moves Malaysian pump prices and Brent within hours.

summary.bm: Rusia berkata ia menyerang dua stesen kuasa di wilayah Kyiv dan Zhytomyr, dan serangan peluru berpandu serta dron Selasa memutuskan bekalan elektrik di kawasan luas. Zelenskiy berkata 33 maut dalam serangan pusat bantuan Komyshuvakha dengan lebih 50 mungkin terperangkap. Kyiv, Moscow dan Washington mengesahkan rundingan peringkat pasukan di Abu Dhabi pada Selasa dan Rabu, pusingan tiga pihak pertama sejak Februari; Zelenskiy berbual 90 minit dengan Witkoff dan Kushner pada 4 Nov, mendesak peluru berpandu pemintas Patriot sebelum musim sejuk. Canselor Jerman Merz berkata beliau belum melihat Rusia serius mengenai gencatan senjata. Korban terkini serangan Komyshuvakha ialah 42 maut, dengan 33 masih tertimbus.
summary.en: Russia says it hit two power stations in the Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions, and Tuesday's missile and drone raids knocked out power across large areas. Zelenskiy says 33 died in the Komyshuvakha aid-hub strike with more than 50 possibly trapped. Kyiv, Moscow and Washington have confirmed team-level talks in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday and Wednesday, the first three-way round since February; Zelenskiy held a 90-minute call with Witkoff and Kushner on Nov 4, pressing for Patriot interceptors before winter. German Chancellor Merz says he does not yet see Russia engaging seriously on a ceasefire. Latest toll from the Komyshuvakha strike is 42 dead, with 33 still buried.

title.bm: Rusia terus menyerang grid kuasa Ukraine ketika rundingan Abu Dhabi anjuran AS disahkan pada 10-11 Nov
title.en: Russia keeps hitting Ukraine's power grid as US-brokered Abu Dhabi talks are confirmed for Nov 10-11

why.bm: Perjanjian akan meredakan tekanan harga tenaga dan bijirin; kegagalan mengekalkan perbelanjaan keselamatan Eropah dan sekatan.
why.en: A deal would ease pressure on energy and grain prices; failure keeps European security spending and sanctions in play.

summary.bm: Suruhanjaya pilihan raya tidak menemui bukti penyelewengan, dan Presiden Herzog menerima keputusan 27 Okt pada 4 Nov, menolak dakwaan tanpa bukti Netanyahu bahawa parti Arab 'mencuri' undi. Blok Netanyahu memegang 53 daripada 120 kerusi dan Eisenkot 48, dengan Ra'am dan Senarai Bersama memenangi rekod 19. Lapan lagi parti, termasuk kedua-dua puak Arab, bertemu Herzog Khamis; beliau kemudian ada beberapa hari menamakan calon yang diberi 28 hari membentuk kerajaan, dan kegagalan bermakna pilihan raya baharu awal tahun depan. Netanyahu bertambah lemah apabila United Torah Judaism menarik sokongan dan sebuah parti Arab menyokong Eisenkot; Herzog mempunyai sehingga 11 Nov untuk menamakan calon.
summary.en: The elections commission found no evidence of irregularities, and President Herzog accepted the Oct 27 results on Nov 4, rebuffing Netanyahu's unsubstantiated claim that Arab-led parties 'stole' the vote. Netanyahu's bloc holds 53 of 120 seats and Eisenkot's 48, with Ra'am and the Joint List winning a record 19. Eight more parties, including both Arab-led factions, see Herzog on Thursday; he then has several days to name a nominee, who gets 28 days to form a government, and failure means a new election early next year. Netanyahu was further weakened when United Torah Judaism withdrew its support and an Arab-led party endorsed Eisenkot; Herzog has until Nov 11 to name a nominee.

title.bm: Herzog terima keputusan pilihan raya Israel yang disahkan dan mulakan rundingan gabungan; Netanyahu mahupun Eisenkot tiada 61 kerusi
title.en: Herzog accepts Israel's certified vote and opens coalition talks; neither Netanyahu nor Eisenkot has 61 seats

why.bm: Kerajaan Israel yang lemah atau buntu menjejaskan rundingan gencatan Gaza, Lebanon dan perang Iran.
why.en: A weak or deadlocked Israeli government affects Gaza ceasefire talks, Lebanon and the Iran war.

summary.bm: Reuters, memetik empat sumber tentera, berkata Houthi paling hampir dengan Aden sejak bulan-bulan awal perang 2015, setelah menawan daerah Al-Maqatirah dan bertempur di sebuah kem di pintu masuk Tur al-Bahah. Serangan Houthi ke atas Arab Saudi meningkat, gabungan pimpinan Saudi menggiatkan serangan, dan gencatan 2022 yang dirunding PBB telah runtuh. Kemaraan itu mengancam jalan yang menghubungkan Aden dan Taiz, yang dikepung sejak awal Oktober dengan lebih 100,000 dipindahkan.
summary.en: Reuters, citing four military sources, says the Houthis are the closest to Aden since the early months of the 2015 war, having taken Al-Maqatirah district and fighting at a camp at the entrance to Tur al-Bahah. Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia have escalated, the Saudi-led coalition has stepped up strikes, and the 2022 UN-brokered truce has broken. The advance threatens the road linking Aden and Taiz, which has been encircled since early October with more than 100,000 displaced.

title.bm: Houthi dalam jarak 80km dari Aden, membuka barisan baharu yang menarik Arab Saudi lebih dalam ke perang Iran
title.en: Houthis within 80km of Aden, opening a new front that draws Saudi Arabia deeper into the Iran war

why.bm: Perkapalan Laut Merah, keselamatan Saudi dan minyak bergantung pada sama ada Aden bertahan.
why.en: Red Sea shipping, Saudi security and oil all depend on whether Aden holds.

summary.bm: Menteri Luar Filipina Lazaro dan Wang Yi dari China berbual telefon dan kedua-duanya menyifatkannya membina, walaupun versi Beijing menuduh Manila 'campur tangan berniat jahat'. Filipina menjadi tuan rumah mesyuarat pemimpin pada 16-18 Nov, dan Rubio berkata sidang kemuncak pemimpin Quad pertama sejak 2024 akan diadakan di Manila serentak, memetik risiko Laut China Selatan dan Selat Taiwan. Perdana Menteri China Li Qiang dijangka hadir.
summary.en: Philippine Foreign Secretary Lazaro and China's Wang Yi spoke by phone and both called it constructive, though Beijing's account accused Manila of 'malicious interference'. The Philippines hosts leaders' meetings from Nov 16-18, and Rubio says the first Quad leaders' summit since 2024 will be held in Manila alongside it, citing South China Sea and Taiwan Strait risks. Chinese Premier Li Qiang is expected to attend.

title.bm: Manila dan Beijing berikrar kekalkan dialog tetapi berbalas kritikan menjelang sidang kemuncak ASEAN di Manila dan mesyuarat pemimpin Quad
title.en: Manila and Beijing pledge dialogue but trade barbs ahead of the Manila ASEAN summit and a Quad leaders' meeting

why.bm: Malaysia berada di tengah diplomasi Laut China Selatan ASEAN dan berdagang dengan kedua-dua kuasa.
why.en: Malaysia sits at the centre of ASEAN's South China Sea diplomacy and trade with both powers.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan serangan di Bandar Gaza dan Khan Younis membunuh sekurang-kurangnya lapan rakyat Palestin, termasuk lima anggota polis. Pegawai kesihatan Gaza mengira sekurang-kurangnya 1,500 terbunuh sejak gencatan, dengan lebih 74,000 dalam keseluruhan perang, manakala Israel berkata empat askarnya maut dalam tempoh itu. Tentera Israel menguasai kira-kira dua pertiga wilayah itu dan perunding belum bersetuju mengenai syarat Hamas melucutkan senjata atau Israel berundur.
summary.en: Reuters reports strikes in Gaza City and Khan Younis killed at least eight Palestinians, including five police officers. Gaza health officials count at least 1,500 killed since the ceasefire, with more than 74,000 in the whole war, while Israel says four of its soldiers have died in the period. Israeli troops control about two-thirds of the territory and negotiators have not agreed terms for Hamas to disarm or Israel to withdraw.

title.bm: Serangan Israel bunuh sekurang-kurangnya lapan di Gaza ketika gencatan setahun semakin goyah dan syarat perlucutan senjata belum dipersetujui
title.en: Israeli strikes kill at least eight in Gaza as the year-old truce frays and disarmament terms stay unagreed

why.bm: Gencatan menjadi asas bantuan Gaza dan pengurangan ketegangan serantau; keruntuhannya menambah risiko Asia Barat.
why.en: The truce underpins Gaza aid and regional de-escalation; its collapse would add to Middle East risk.

summary.bm: Sudan mengemukakan aduan kepada Majlis Keselamatan PBB dan Kesatuan Afrika, mencatatkan 70 serangan dengan 187 dron yang didakwanya dilancarkan dari wilayah Ethiopia antara Februari dan Oktober, 97 daripadanya pada Oktober sahaja. Ia melaporkan 484 orang awam dan 176 askar terbunuh serta lebih 90% stesen janakuasa bandar lumpuh. Ethiopia menafikan menyokong RSF, dan penganalisis memberitahu Al Jazeera bahawa kebimbangan terhadap peningkatan konflik serantau setakat ini menghalang pertempuran terbuka.
summary.en: Sudan has complained to the UN Security Council and African Union, counting 70 assaults with 187 drones it says were launched from Ethiopian territory between February and October, 97 of them in October alone. It reports 484 civilians and 176 soldiers killed and over 90% of city power stations out of service. Ethiopia denies backing the RSF, and analysts told Al Jazeera that fear of regional escalation is so far preventing open conflict.

title.bm: Sudan bawa Ethiopia ke PBB atas serangan dron RSF, mencetuskan kebimbangan perang lebih luas
title.en: Sudan takes Ethiopia to the UN over RSF drone attacks, raising fears of a wider war

why.bm: Krisis pelarian melibatkan kira-kira 13 juta orang boleh merebak ke seluruh Tanduk Afrika, bersebelahan laluan perkapalan Laut Merah yang sama.
why.en: A displacement crisis of about 13 million people could spread across the Horn of Africa, next to the same Red Sea shipping routes.

summary.bm: Kiraan terkini CIDRAP ialah 10,444 kes dan 5,376 kematian (5,372 di DRC, masing-masing dua di Kenya dan Uganda), kadar kematian 51.6%, tertumpu di Ituri dan Kivu Utara. Penjejakan kontak masih terhad dan tiada vaksin atau rawatan diluluskan untuk strain Bundibugyo. Pada 4 Nov WHO menyokong dua lagi calon vaksin (ChAdOx1 Oxford dan mRNA-1469 Moderna) untuk ujian Tumaini di Ituri, menunggu kelulusan kebangsaan; keputusan dijangka awal 2027.
summary.en: CIDRAP's latest tally is 10,444 cases and 5,376 deaths (5,372 in DRC, two each in Kenya and Uganda), a fatality rate of 51.6%, centred on Ituri and North Kivu. Contact tracing remains limited and there is no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. On Nov 4 WHO backed two more candidate vaccines (Oxford ChAdOx1 and Moderna mRNA-1469) for the Tumaini trial in Ituri, pending national approvals; trial results are expected in early 2027.

title.bm: Ebola (Bundibugyo) di DRC: 5,376 kematian dan 10,444 kes ketika wabak memasuki bulan ketujuh
title.en: Ebola (Bundibugyo) in DRC: 5,376 deaths and 10,444 cases as outbreak enters seventh month

why.bm: Risiko kepada Malaysia rendah, tetapi pelancong ke Afrika Tengah/Timur perlu ikut nasihat kesihatan, elak kontak dengan orang sakit dan lapor demam selepas pulang. WHO menasihatkan agar tiada sekatan perjalanan atau perdagangan.
why.en: Risk to Malaysia is low, but travellers to Central/East Africa should follow health advisories, avoid contact with sick people and report fever after return. WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions.

summary.bm: CDC merekodkan 4,852 kes disahkan di AS setakat 30 Okt, paling banyak dalam 35 tahun. Seorang kanak-kanak meninggal di Lewis County, New York (210 kes negeri), manakala Pennsylvania mencatat 1,433 kes dengan lima kematian tahun ini.
summary.en: The CDC counted 4,852 confirmed US cases as of Oct 30, the most in 35 years. A child died in Lewis County, New York (210 state cases), and Pennsylvania has 1,433 cases with five deaths this year.

title.bm: Kes campak AS lebih 4,850; New York laporkan kematian kanak-kanak pertama dalam 30 tahun
title.en: US measles passes 4,850 cases; New York reports first child death in 30 years

why.bm: Semak rekod vaksin MMR kanak-kanak sebelum melancong, terutamanya ke AS.
why.en: Check children's MMR records before travelling, especially to the US.

summary.bm: Dua kes disahkan klade 1 dan dua lagi disyaki menunggu analisis; tiga pesakit berkata mereka tidak keluar dari daerah itu setahun lalu. Klade 1 mempunyai kadar kematian dilaporkan 1% hingga 10%, berbanding 1% hingga 4% bagi klade 2.
summary.en: Two cases are confirmed clade 1 and two are suspected pending analysis; three patients say they did not leave the county in the past year. Clade 1 has a reported fatality rate of 1% to 10%, versus 1% to 4% for clade 2.

title.bm: California siasat empat kes mpox klade 1 di Stanislaus County, tiga tanpa sejarah perjalanan
title.en: California investigates four clade 1 mpox cases in Stanislaus County, three with no travel

why.bm: Penularan tempatan menunjukkan jangkitan tidak dikesan; elak sentuhan rapat dengan orang berruam dan dapatkan rawatan awal jika bergejala.
why.en: Local spread suggests undetected transmission; avoid close contact with anyone with a rash and seek care early if symptoms appear.

summary.bm: CHP Hong Kong melaporkan seorang budak lelaki 2 tahun di Hubei dan wanita 77 tahun di Jiangxi, laporan pertama sejak Ogos. Tanah besar China mencatat 22 kes lain dalam enam bulan dan 164 jangkitan H9N2 pada manusia sejak 2015, termasuk dua kematian.
summary.en: Hong Kong's CHP reported a 2-year-old boy in Hubei and a 77-year-old woman in Jiangxi, the first such reports since August. Mainland China has had 22 other cases in six months and 164 human H9N2 infections since 2015, including two deaths.

title.bm: China laporkan dua kes baharu selesema burung H9N2 pada manusia di Hubei dan Jiangxi
title.en: China reports two new human H9N2 bird flu cases in Hubei and Jiangxi

why.bm: Elak pasar ayam hidup dan burung sakit semasa melancong di China; penularan antara manusia tidak dilaporkan.
why.en: Avoid live poultry markets and sick birds when travelling in China; human-to-human spread is not reported.

summary.bm: CIDRAP berkata Kenya mencatat kematian kedua manakala Nigeria berusaha memahami penularan pesakit indeksnya. WHO merekodkan 9 kes di Kenya setakat 20 Okt.
summary.en: CIDRAP says Kenya has a second death while Nigeria races to understand transmission of its index patient. WHO counted 9 Kenyan cases as of Oct 20.

title.bm: Kenya laporkan kematian Ebola kedua, Nigeria siasat punca jangkitan pesakit pertama
title.en: Kenya reports second Ebola death as Nigeria probes how its first patient was infected

why.bm: Pelancong ke Afrika Timur/Barat perlu ikut nasihat kesihatan dan melapor demam selepas pulang.
why.en: Travellers to East/West Africa should follow advisories and report fever after return.

summary.bm: GMS 9.5.2 dan lebih awal terjejas oleh CVE-2026-109593 (CVSS 9.1, baca fail tanpa pengesahan) dan CVE-2026-109594 (CVSS 6.8, suntikan SQL selepas pengesahan); tiada pembaikan akan dikeluarkan. Secara berasingan, SSRF SonicWall CVSS 10.0, CVE-2026-102255, sedang diserang secara aktif.
summary.en: GMS 9.5.2 and earlier is affected by CVE-2026-109593 (CVSS 9.1, unauthenticated file read) and CVE-2026-109594 (CVSS 6.8, post-auth SQL injection); no fix will be released. Separately, a CVSS 10.0 SonicWall SSRF, CVE-2026-102255, is under active attack.

title.bm: SonicWall tidak akan menampal dua kelemahan GMS tamat hayat, termasuk pepijat baca fail 9.1
title.en: SonicWall will not patch two EoL GMS flaws, including a 9.1 file-read bug

why.bm: Pasukan rangkaian: berhijrah daripada GMS ke Network Security Manager dan jangan dedahkan GMS ke Internet; tampal kelemahan SonicWall yang satu lagi.
why.en: Network teams: migrate off GMS to Network Security Manager and keep GMS off the internet; patch the other SonicWall flaw.

summary.bm: CVE-2026-109518 melibatkan penyerang yang boleh mengubah muat turun pakej HTTP apabila APT mencuba semula muat turun gagal, tetapan lalai pada Debian 12 dan Ubuntu 22.04 ke atas. Pembaikan termasuk APT 2.8.4ubuntu0.1 pada Ubuntu 24.04 dan 2.4.15ubuntu0.1 pada 22.04.
summary.en: CVE-2026-109518 affects attackers who can alter HTTP package downloads when APT retries failed fetches, the default on Debian 12 and Ubuntu 22.04 and later. Fixes include APT 2.8.4ubuntu0.1 on Ubuntu 24.04 and 2.4.15ubuntu0.1 on 22.04.

title.bm: Kelemahan APT Debian dan Ubuntu benarkan penyerang rangkaian tukar pakej dan jalankan kod sebagai root
title.en: Debian and Ubuntu APT flaw lets a network attacker swap packages and run code as root

why.bm: Jalankan apt update dan upgrade pada pelayan sekarang, dan guna cermin HTTPS yang dipercayai.
why.en: Run apt update and upgrade on servers now, and use HTTPS mirrors you trust.

summary.bm: SecurityWeek berkata penyerang menuai token akses AI dan menggunakan alat bantuan AI untuk mengautomasikan pencerobohan. Chainstack berkata penyerang masuk ke persekitaran dev pada 26 Okt, sampai ke produksi dan disekat 31 Okt, mendedahkan data pelanggan dan cincangan kata laluan.
summary.en: SecurityWeek says attackers are harvesting AI access tokens and using AI-assisted tools to automate intrusions. Chainstack says an attacker entered a dev environment on Oct 26, reached production and was cut off Oct 31, exposing customer data and password hashes.

title.bm: WorkOS, Northflank, Trigger.dev dan Chainstack dedah pelanggaran berkaitan serangan dibantu AI
title.en: WorkOS, Northflank, Trigger.dev and Chainstack disclose breaches tied to AI-assisted attacks

why.bm: Jika anda guna vendor ini, tukar kunci API dan token serta tetapkan semula kata laluan.
why.en: If you use these vendors, rotate API keys and tokens and reset passwords.

summary.bm: BleepingComputer melaporkan Zyxel membaiki zero-day dalam siri suis GS1900 yang digunakan penyerang terhadap hampir 1,000 peranti.
summary.en: BleepingComputer reports Zyxel fixed a zero-day in its GS1900 switch series that attackers used against nearly 1,000 devices.

title.bm: Zyxel tampal zero-day yang dieksploitasi untuk menggodam hampir 1,000 suis rangkaian
title.en: Zyxel patches zero-day exploited to hack nearly 1,000 network switches

why.bm: Pasukan rangkaian: pasang kemas kini firmware Zyxel, hadkan akses pengurusan dan semak suis GS1900 untuk tanda kompromi.
why.en: Network teams: apply the Zyxel firmware fix, restrict management access and check GS1900 switches for compromise.

summary.bm: CVE-2026-116606 (CVSS 9.3) dan CVE-2026-111560 (CVSS 8.6) boleh dirantai untuk akses root pada peranti Barracuda, menurut The Hacker News dan SecurityWeek.
summary.en: CVE-2026-116606 (CVSS 9.3) and CVE-2026-111560 (CVSS 8.6) can be chained for root access on Barracuda devices, per The Hacker News and SecurityWeek.

title.bm: Kelemahan Barracuda boleh dirantai untuk pintas kebenaran dan dapat akses root pada gateway e-mel
title.en: Barracuda flaws can be chained to bypass authorisation and gain root on email gateways

why.bm: Pasang tampalan Barracuda sekarang dan hadkan pendedahan antara muka pengurusan.
why.en: Apply Barracuda's patches now and limit management interface exposure.

summary.bm: Binance berkata perekrut palsu memperdaya jurutera dompet membuka tugasan pengekodan berniat jahat yang terlepas daripada alat keselamatannya, kemudian mencapai komputer dua lagi jurutera dan sistem yang mengawal berbilion dolar. FBI menyalahkan Korea Utara, yang menafikannya. Kira-kira 233 juta XRP keluar dari lima dompet dalam empat minit, Binance membekukan kira-kira $2.85 bilion dan akan membayar balik pelanggan, dan Reuters berkata pengguna mengeluarkan kira-kira $4.64 bilion selepas pengeluaran disambung semula. FBI menamakan kumpulan TraderTraitor yang sejajar dengan Korea Utara dan meletakkan kecurian itu pada kira-kira $6.43 bilion, dengan $2.85 bilion dibekukan di rantaian oleh Tether, Circle, Ripple dan lain-lain.
summary.en: Binance says fake recruiters got a wallet engineer to open a malicious coding task its security tools missed, then reached two more engineers' machines and systems controlling billions. The FBI blames North Korea, which denies it. About 233m XRP left five wallets in four minutes, Binance froze about $2.85bn and will reimburse customers, and Reuters says users withdrew about $4.64bn after withdrawals resumed. The FBI names the North Korea-aligned TraderTraitor group and puts the theft at about $6.43bn, with $2.85bn frozen on-chain by Tether, Circle, Ripple and others.

title.bm: Binance dedah bagaimana temu duga kerja palsu membawa kepada kecurian kripto rekod $6.3 bilion
title.en: Binance details how a fake job interview led to the record $6.3bn crypto theft

why.bm: Tawaran kerja palsu ialah risiko sebenar bagi pembangun dan kakitangan IT Malaysia, jadi anggap ujian pengekodan daripada perekrut sebagai fail tidak dipercayai.
why.en: Fake job offers are a real risk for Malaysian developers and IT staff, so treat coding tests from recruiters as untrusted files.

summary.bm: Presiden OpenAI Greg Brockman memberitahu persidangan teknologi Wall Street Journal bahawa jualan perusahaan kini majoriti hasil. Apabila ditanya sama ada OpenAI boleh bersedia untuk disenaraikan tahun depan, beliau menjawab 'I think so'. Reuters menyatakan OpenAI sedang mempromosikan ejen Codex kepada perniagaan bagi bersaing dengan Anthropic, yang dijangka disenaraikan dahulu.
summary.en: OpenAI president Greg Brockman told a Wall Street Journal tech conference that enterprise sales are now the majority of revenue. Asked if OpenAI could be ready to list next year, he said 'I think so'. Reuters notes OpenAI is pushing its Codex agent to businesses to compete with Anthropic, which is expected to list first.

title.bm: Brockman OpenAI: kebanyakan hasil kini dari perusahaan dan syarikat mungkin sedia untuk IPO pada 2027
title.en: OpenAI's Brockman says it now earns most revenue from enterprises and could be IPO-ready in 2027

why.bm: Ini menunjukkan persaingan OpenAI-Anthropic beralih daripada pengguna ke bajet korporat dan pasaran awam.
why.en: It signals the OpenAI-Anthropic race is moving from consumers to corporate budgets and public markets.

summary.bm: Meta mengesahkan telah membeli Conductor, yang alatannya menjalankan beberapa ejen pengekodan dalam ruang kerja selari; harga tidak didedahkan. Perkhidmatan awan Conductor ditutup pada 20 Nov dan data awan pengguna akan dipadam, manakala pengasasnya mengisyaratkan produk baharu menjelang awal tahun depan.
summary.en: Meta confirmed it has acquired Conductor, whose tool runs several coding agents in parallel workspaces; no price was disclosed. Conductor's cloud service shuts on Nov 20 and user cloud data will be deleted, while its founder teased a new product by early next year.

title.bm: Meta beli syarikat pemula pengekodan AI Conductor
title.en: Meta buys AI coding startup Conductor

why.bm: Meta membeli jalan masuk ke ejen pengekodan AI, pasaran yang diterajui Anthropic dan OpenAI, dan pengguna Conductor perlu mengeksport data sebelum 20 Nov.
why.en: Meta is buying its way into AI coding agents, a market led by Anthropic and OpenAI, and Conductor users must export data before Nov 20.

summary.bm: Google berkata pada 3 Nov bahawa mulai tahun depan alat AI termasuk Gemini, NotebookLM dan Gemini dalam Classroom akan dimatikan untuk pelajar K-12 melainkan pentadbir menghidupkannya. Memandangkan AI tertanam dalam Search, sekolah yang menyekat AI sepenuhnya juga akan kehilangan Search untuk pelajar.
summary.en: Google said on Nov 3 that from next year AI tools including Gemini, NotebookLM and Gemini in Classroom will be off for K-12 students unless administrators turn them on. Because AI is built into Search, schools that block AI entirely will also lose Search for students.

title.bm: Google akan matikan Gemini dan alat AI untuk pelajar K-12 melainkan sekolah memilih untuk menghidupkannya, dan Search turut hilang
title.en: Google will switch off Gemini and AI tools for K-12 students unless schools opt in, and Search goes with them

why.bm: Ia menunjukkan AI kini dibundel dalam produk teras Google, menyebabkan sekolah berdepan pilihan sukar.
why.en: It shows how AI is now bundled into core Google products, leaving schools a hard choice.

summary.bm: Dalam S-1/A yang disemak, Anthropic menyatakan anggaran dalaman menunjukkan ia mungkin tidak lama lagi memenuhi takrifan Dasar Penskalaan Bertanggungjawabnya bagi kemajuan yang dipercepat secara dramatik oleh AI, walaupun tiada model semasa dilabel melepasi garis itu. Ia berkata tidak menjangka membenarkan Claude membina model termaju secara berturut-turut tanpa pengawasan manusia yang bermakna dan sedang mempertimbangkan kemas kini dasar.
summary.en: In its revised S-1/A, Anthropic says internal estimates suggest it may soon meet its Responsible Scaling Policy definition of AI-driven dramatically accelerated progress, though it has not labelled any current model as crossing that line. It says it does not expect to let Claude build successive frontier models without meaningful human oversight and is considering policy updates.

title.bm: Pemfailan IPO Anthropic beri amaran ia mungkin tidak lama lagi mencapai pembangunan AI yang memecut sendiri
title.en: Anthropic's IPO filing warns it may soon reach self-accelerating AI development

why.bm: Makmal termaju meletakkan risiko ini dalam pemfailan sekuriti ialah isyarat penting kepada pengawal selia dan pelabur.
why.en: A frontier lab putting this risk in a securities filing is a notable signal for regulators and investors.

summary.bm: Kementerian Komunikasi memberitahu Parlimen dakwaan itu akan dikendalikan di bawah Akta Komunikasi dan Multimedia serta Akta Keselamatan Dalam Talian. Laporan ancaman Anthropic pada September menyatakan sebuah firma berpangkalan di Istanbul, yang menafikannya, menggunakan Claude merancang rangkaian persona palsu dan memprofil kesemua 222 kerusi persekutuan; Anthropic berkata ia menutup akaun tersebut dan tidak melihat penglibatan bermakna. Kementerian tidak menyatakan sama ada Anthropic telah menjawab.
summary.en: The Communications Ministry told Parliament the claims will be handled under the Communications and Multimedia Act and Online Safety Act. Anthropic's September threat report said an Istanbul-based firm, which denies it, used Claude to plan fake persona networks and profile all 222 federal seats; Anthropic says it shut the accounts and saw no meaningful engagement. The ministry did not say whether Anthropic has replied.

title.bm: MCMC minta bukti daripada Anthropic tentang rancangan pengaruh guna Claude yang menyasarkan pengundi Malaysia
title.en: MCMC asks Anthropic for evidence on a Claude-aided influence plan aimed at Malaysian voters

why.bm: Ini ujian awal sejauh mana undang-undang Malaysia menjangkau penyalahgunaan AI di luar negara, ketika pilihan raya negeri berlangsung dan RUU Tadbir Urus AI sedang digubal.
why.en: It is an early test of how Malaysian law reaches AI misuse abroad, with state polls under way and an AI Governance Bill being drafted.

summary.bm: Moonshot menjanjikan pemberat penuh keluarga model hampir 3 trilion parameter ini menjelang 4 Nov, tetapi tiada pelepasan yang disahkan ditemui setakat ini. Moonshot melaporkan 65.7% pada Terminal-Bench 4.0, berbanding 66.4% untuk Claude Opus 5.5 dan 58.2% untuk GPT-6 Astra, angka sendiri yang belum disahkan. Ia berkata bahan serangan siber dibuang daripada latihan, sekali gus menurunkan skor ujian eksploitasinya daripada 90.5% kepada 81%.
summary.en: Moonshot promised the full weights of the nearly 3-trillion-parameter family by Nov 4, but we found no confirmed release at the time of writing. Moonshot reports 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, against 66.4% for Claude Opus 5.5 and 58.2% for GPT-6 Astra, figures that are its own and unverified. It says it removed cyberattack material from training, which cut its exploit test score from 90.5% to 81%.

title.bm: Tarikh akhir pemberat terbuka Kimi K3.1 Pro tiba; belum ada pengesahan pelepasan
title.en: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro open-weights deadline is here; no confirmed release yet

why.bm: Pemberat terbuka yang hampir setaraf model termaju membolehkan syarikat menjalankan model kuat pada perkakasan sendiri tanpa bergantung pada API AS atau China, sesuatu yang penting bagi firma Malaysia yang sensitif tentang data.
why.en: Open weights near the frontier would let companies run a strong model on their own hardware rather than rely on US or Chinese hosted APIs, which matters for data-sensitive Malaysian firms.

summary.bm: ProductNation melaporkan pra-pesanan dibuka di kedai Apple Malaysia, dengan ketersediaan dari 6 Nov. iPad mini OLED bermula RM2,999 (128GB Wi-Fi, tambah RM700 untuk selular), dan MacBook Pro 14 inci M5 Pro skrin sentuh dengan 24GB dan 1TB bermula RM11,999.
summary.en: ProductNation reports pre-orders are open on Apple's Malaysian store, with availability from Nov 6. The OLED iPad mini starts at RM2,999 (128GB Wi-Fi, RM700 more for cellular), and the touchscreen 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB and 1TB starts at RM11,999.

title.bm: Harga Malaysia ditetapkan: MacBook Pro skrin sentuh dari RM11,999, iPad mini dari RM2,999, dihantar 6 Nov
title.en: Malaysia prices set: touchscreen MacBook Pro from RM11,999, iPad mini from RM2,999, shipping Nov 6

why.bm: Ini menjawab persoalan harga Malaysia sebelum pelancaran Jumaat.
why.en: This answers the open Malaysian pricing question before Friday's launch.

summary.bm: Bermula iOS, iPadOS, macOS dan visionOS 27.3, fail dan foto yang dikongsi dengan 'sesiapa yang ada pautan' boleh diakses Apple untuk semakan, walaupun Advanced Data Protection dihidupkan. Pautan yang dikongsi hanya dengan individu tertentu dikecualikan, dan Apple boleh membuang kandungan atau melumpuhkan akaun, dengan keluaran awam dijangka pada Disember.
summary.en: From iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS 27.3, files and photos shared with 'Anyone with the link' become accessible to Apple for review, even with Advanced Data Protection on. Links shared only with named people are excluded, and Apple may remove content or disable accounts, with public release expected in December.

title.bm: Apple akan semak pautan iCloud awam untuk kandungan berbahaya mulai iOS 27.3, menamatkan penyulitan hujung ke hujung bagi pautan itu
title.en: Apple will review public iCloud links for harmful content from iOS 27.3, ending end-to-end encryption for them

why.bm: Jika anda berkongsi pautan iCloud secara awam, anggap ia tidak peribadi; kongsi dengan individu tertentu sebaliknya.
why.en: If you share iCloud links publicly, treat them as non-private; share with named people instead.

summary.bm: Pembangun kini boleh menetapkan mesej pengekalan dalam App Store Connect yang muncul dalam aliran pembatalan, dengan teks, imej atau tawaran khas. API Retention Messaging yang berasingan, tersedia atas permintaan, membolehkan aplikasi memilih mesej bagi setiap pelanggan.
summary.en: Developers can now set retention messages in App Store Connect that appear in the cancellation flow, with text, images or a special offer. A separate Retention Messaging API, available by request, lets apps choose messages per subscriber.

title.bm: App Store benarkan pembangun papar tawaran pengekalan apabila pelanggan cuba membatalkan langganan
title.en: App Store lets developers show retention offers when subscribers try to cancel

why.bm: Jangkakan tawaran diskaun apabila anda membatalkan langganan aplikasi.
why.en: Expect discount offers when you cancel an app subscription.

summary.bm: MacRumors berkata beta pembangun pertama iOS 27.3 dijadual 3 Nov dengan keluaran awam pada Disember. Di China ia mengaktifkan Writing Tools, Genmoji dan Visual Intelligence pada iPhone 15 Pro ke atas, dengan Qwen Alibaba ditambah ke Siri.
summary.en: MacRumors says the first iOS 27.3 developer beta was due Nov 3 with a public release in December. In China it enables Writing Tools, Genmoji and Visual Intelligence on iPhone 15 Pro and newer, with Alibaba's Qwen added to Siri.

title.bm: Beta iOS 27.3 bermula; Apple Intelligence di China akan guna Qwen Alibaba
title.en: iOS 27.3 beta begins; Apple Intelligence in China will use Alibaba's Qwen

why.bm: Menunjukkan cara Apple menyesuaikan ciri AI dengan peraturan dan rakan tempatan; tiada perubahan untuk pengguna Malaysia daripada berita ini.
why.en: Shows how Apple adapts AI features to local rules and partners; no change for Malaysian users from this item.

summary.bm: Honor mengaitkan telefon ini dengan Festival Filem Malaysia ke-35 (anugerah pada 21 Nov), dan Magic9 biasa mungkin turut dilancarkan di sini. Versi China mempunyai OLED LTPO 6.8 inci, Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, bateri 8,800mAh serta kamera utama dan telefoto 200MP, dari CNY6,499 (kira-kira RM3,900).
summary.en: Honor tied the phone to the 35th Malaysia Film Festival (awards on Nov 21), and the standard Magic9 may also launch locally. The China version has a 6.8-inch LTPO OLED, Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, 8,800mAh battery and 200MP main and telephoto cameras, from CNY6,499 (about RM3,900).

title.bm: Honor sahkan Magic9 Pro Max akan ke Malaysia, tarikh dan harga belum diumumkan
title.en: Honor confirms Magic9 Pro Max is coming to Malaysia, no date or price yet

why.bm: Spesifikasi dan harga untuk Malaysia mungkin berbeza daripada China, jadi tunggu pelancaran tempatan.
why.en: Specs and price for Malaysia may differ from China, so wait for the local launch.

summary.bm: Kumpulan Threat Intelligence Google dan polis Jepun mengganggu pelayan kawalan dan mengharamkan pembuat Videostrong daripada menghasilkan peranti Android bertauliah. Penutupan itu tidak membersihkan kotak yang dijangkiti, dan Google berkata ia mungkin memutuskan sekurang-kurangnya 10 juta lagi peranti yang terjejas.
summary.en: Google's Threat Intelligence Group and Japan's police disrupted the command servers and banned maker Videostrong from making certified Android devices. The takedown does not clean infected boxes, and Google says it may cut off at least 10 million more compromised devices.

title.bm: Google ganggu botnet XCPE yang menjangkiti lebih 1.3 juta kotak Android TV
title.en: Google disrupts XCPE botnet that infected over 1.3 million Android TV boxes

why.bm: Kotak Android TV murah tanpa jenama biasa di Malaysia; semak kotak anda dan pertimbangkan menggantinya jika terjejas.
why.en: Cheap unbranded Android TV boxes are common in Malaysia; check yours and consider replacing it if it is affected.

summary.bm: Sammy Fans melaporkan Samsung kini menyediakan beta One UI 9.5, dengan Galaxy S26 mengetuai senarai pelancaran. Butiran lanjut selain tajuk itu tidak dapat disahkan dalam larian ini.
summary.en: Sammy Fans reports Samsung is now preparing the One UI 9.5 beta, with the Galaxy S26 leading the rollout list. Details beyond that headline could not be confirmed in this run.

title.bm: Samsung mulakan beta One UI 9.5, siri Galaxy S26 di barisan pertama
title.en: Samsung starts a One UI 9.5 beta, with the Galaxy S26 series first in line

why.bm: Perisian beta mungkin tidak stabil; tunggu keluaran stabil melainkan anda selesa menguji.
why.en: Beta software can be unstable; wait for the stable release unless you are comfortable testing.

summary.bm: SecurityWeek berkata kemas kini November membaiki lebih 200 kelemahan; The Hacker News menyebut CVE-2026-58868, kelemahan kritikal yang membolehkan pelaksanaan kod jauh tanpa interaksi pengguna pada Android 14 hingga 17.
summary.en: SecurityWeek says the November updates fix over 200 vulnerabilities; The Hacker News notes CVE-2026-58868, a critical flaw allowing remote code execution without user interaction on Android 14 to 17.

title.bm: Kemas kini Android November tampal 200+ kelemahan, termasuk RCE kritikal CVE-2026-58868
title.en: Android November updates patch 200+ flaws, including critical RCE CVE-2026-58868

why.bm: Pasang kemas kini keselamatan Android terkini sebaik sahaja tersedia pada telefon anda.
why.en: Install the latest Android security update as soon as it reaches your phone.

summary.bm: Reuters berkata caj bukan tunai itu dicatat pada Q3, berkaitan waran yang membolehkan Meta membeli sehingga 10% AMD di bawah perjanjian sehingga $60 bilion cip AI, dan OpenAI pegangan serupa. Pencairan hanya bermula selepas syarat pemberian dan penghantaran dipenuhi, dan ramalan pertumbuhan 2027 AMD yang lebih pantas menaikkan saham kira-kira 8% selepas waktu dagangan.
summary.en: Reuters says the non-cash charge hit Q3, tied to warrants that could let Meta buy up to 10% of AMD under a deal for up to $60bn of AI chips, and OpenAI a similar stake. Dilution only starts once vesting and shipment conditions are met, and AMD's faster 2027 growth forecast lifted shares about 8% after hours.

title.bm: AMD catat caj $1.07 bilion atas waran berkaitan perjanjian cip OpenAI dan Meta
title.en: AMD books $1.07bn charge on warrants tied to its OpenAI and Meta chip deals

why.bm: Pembuat cip kini membayar permintaan AI dengan ekuiti, corak yang wajar diperhatikan merentas sektor.
why.en: Chip makers are now paying for AI demand with equity, a pattern worth watching across the sector.

summary.bm: Diumumkan di AWS Cloud and AI Day di Kuala Lumpur, ia merangkumi perintis GovHub untuk 500 pembangun meningkat kepada 4,000 menjelang 2028 dan Amazon Quick untuk 445,000 pegawai. PKS mendapat akses percuma Quick dan Kiro selama enam bulan selepas penilaian, selaras komitmen AWS sebanyak RM29.2 bilion di Malaysia.
summary.en: Announced at AWS Cloud and AI Day in Kuala Lumpur, it includes a GovHub pilot for 500 developers rising to 4,000 by 2028 and Amazon Quick for 445,000 officers. SMEs get six months of free Quick and Kiro access after an assessment, building on AWS's RM29.2 billion Malaysian commitment.

title.bm: AWS lancar Semarak AI Malaysia, tawar alat AI kepada 445,000 pegawai kerajaan dan 10,000 PKS menjelang 2028
title.en: AWS launches Semarak AI Malaysia, offering AI tools to 445,000 government officers and 10,000 SMEs by 2028

why.bm: Ia membawa alat AI percuma kepada PKS dan perkhidmatan awam Malaysia, bukan sekadar perbelanjaan pusat data.
why.en: It brings free AI tooling to Malaysian SMEs and the civil service, not just data-centre spending.

summary.bm: SpaceX memilih platform infrastruktur Dragonwing QRU100 dan QDU100 Qualcomm untuk Starlink Mobile, yang Qualcomm gelar perjanjian 5G terbesarnya, menurut Reuters. Kira-kira seminggu lebih awal T-Mobile dilaporkan berkata tiada ruang untuk perjanjian MVNO dengan SpaceX.
summary.en: SpaceX picked Qualcomm's Dragonwing QRU100 and QDU100 infrastructure platforms for Starlink Mobile, which Qualcomm called its biggest 5G deal yet, per Reuters. About a week earlier T-Mobile reportedly said there was no room for an MVNO deal with SpaceX.

title.bm: Qualcomm dan SpaceX bersetuju bina rangkaian 5G Starlink dengan sasaran debut AS pada 2027
title.en: Qualcomm and SpaceX agree to build a Starlink 5G network aimed at a 2027 US debut

why.bm: SpaceX sedang membina rangkaian mudah alihnya sendiri, yang akhirnya boleh mencabar syarikat telekom.
why.en: SpaceX is building its own mobile network, which could eventually challenge telcos.

summary.bm: Anwar memberitahu Dewan Rakyat kerajaan mempunyai maklumat tentang ancaman berpotensi dan meminta MKN memberi taklimat tertutup kepada semua ahli parlimen. Langkah termasuk penyelarasan lebih rapat dan perlindungan lebih kukuh bagi tenaga, pengangkutan, kewangan dan bekalan makanan, dan Bank Negara akan bertemu institusi kewangan.
summary.en: Anwar told the Dewan Rakyat the government has information on potential threats and asked MKN to brief all MPs behind closed doors. Measures include tighter coordination and stronger protection of energy, transport, finance and food supply, and Bank Negara will meet financial institutions.

title.bm: Anwar amaran Malaysia mungkin menjadi sasaran serangan siber dan arah taklimat keselamatan
title.en: Anwar warns Malaysia could be a target of cyberattacks and orders security briefings

why.bm: Ia menaikkan tahap kesiapsiagaan siber bagi bank dan pengendali infrastruktur kritikal di Malaysia.
why.en: It raises the cyber readiness bar for banks and critical-infrastructure operators in Malaysia.

summary.bm: Google berkata tambahan AS$15 bilion akan mengembangkan pusat datanya di Malaysia dalam dua tahun dan menjangka 37,000 pekerjaan. Anwar mengalu-alukan pelaburan itu.
summary.en: Google says the extra US$15 billion will expand its Malaysian data centre footprint over two years and projects 37,000 jobs. Anwar hailed the investment.

title.bm: Google tambah komitmen AS$15 bilion untuk pusat data Malaysia dalam tempoh dua tahun
title.en: Google commits another US$15bn to Malaysian data centres over two years

why.bm: Rangsangan besar kepada ekosistem pusat data dan awan serta pekerjaan teknologi di Malaysia.
why.en: A big boost for Malaysia's data-centre and cloud ecosystem and tech jobs.

summary.bm: Pembinaan sambungan ke Penang Sentral dijadual bermula 2027 dan siap menjelang 2031.
summary.en: Construction of the link to Penang Sentral is set for 2027, with completion targeted for 2031.

title.bm: Sambungan LRT Laluan Mutiara ke Penang Sentral mula dibina 2027
title.en: Mutiara Line LRT link to Penang Sentral to start construction in 2027

why.bm: Memberi penumpang tanah besar Pulau Pinang sambungan rel ke pulau.
why.en: Gives mainland Penang commuters a rail link to the island.

summary.bm: Bantuan sekali bayar RM600 bermula 2027, manakala kriteria permohonan diumumkan bulan depan.
summary.en: The one-off RM600 aid starts in 2027, with application criteria to be announced next month.

title.bm: Pemandu e-hailing Pulau Pinang terima bantuan sekali bayar RM600 mulai 2027
title.en: Penang e-hailing drivers to get one-off RM600 aid from 2027

why.bm: Membantu pemandu gig; nantikan syarat kelayakan pada Disember.
why.en: Helps gig drivers; watch for eligibility rules in December.

summary.bm: The Star melaporkan 598 individu berprofil tinggi, termasuk VVIP, Ahli Parlimen dan ADUN, gagal menunaikan caruman PERKESO pekerja domestik mereka, menurut Menteri Ramanan.
summary.en: The Star reports 598 high-profile individuals, including VVIPs, MPs and state assemblymen, failed to meet PERKESO obligations for their domestic workers, according to Minister Ramanan.

title.bm: Hampir 600 VVIP dan Ahli Parlimen tidak caruman PERKESO untuk pekerja domestik
title.en: Nearly 600 VVIPs and MPs did not contribute to PERKESO for domestic workers

why.bm: Pekerja domestik berhak mendapat perlindungan keselamatan sosial.
why.en: Domestic workers are entitled to social security cover.

summary.bm: Polis menahan 35 orang dalam operasi membanteras sindiket penipuan cinta dan pelaburan emas.
summary.en: Police arrested 35 people in a crackdown on a love scam and gold investment fraud syndicate.

title.bm: 35 ditahan dalam serbuan sindiket penipuan cinta dan pelaburan emas
title.en: 35 arrested in crackdown on love scam and gold investment fraud syndicate

why.bm: Berwaspada dengan penipuan cinta dalam talian dan skim emas 'untung terjamin'.
why.en: Be wary of online romance and 'guaranteed return' gold schemes.

summary.bm: CISA menambah CVE-2024-27834 (CVSS 5.5, pintasan Pointer Authentication, dibaiki Mei 2024) ke katalog KEV pada 4 Nov, dengan tarikh akhir tampalan persekutuan 18 Nov. Laporan Sekoia mengaitkan kempen ini dengan APT29 pada tahap keyakinan sederhana ke tinggi, menggunakan laman web terjejas dan palsu serta serangan rantaian bekalan Plerdy SEO Tracker.
summary.en: CISA added CVE-2024-27834 (CVSS 5.5, Pointer Authentication bypass, fixed in May 2024) to its KEV catalog on Nov 4, with a federal patch deadline of Nov 18. A Sekoia report attributes the campaign to APT29 with moderate-to-high confidence, using compromised and fake websites and a Plerdy SEO Tracker supply-chain attack.

title.bm: CISA tambah kelemahan lama Apple (CVE-2024-27834) ke senarai dieksploitasi apabila APT29 yang dikaitkan dengan Rusia menggunakannya dalam serangan pencuri maklumat
title.en: CISA adds an old Apple flaw (CVE-2024-27834) to its exploited list as Russia-linked APT29 uses it in info-stealer attacks

why.bm: Kemas kini iPhone, iPad, Mac dan Safari ke versi terkini; peranti pada iOS 16/17 atau macOS lama berisiko.
why.en: Update iPhones, iPads, Macs and Safari to current versions; devices on iOS 16/17 or older macOS are at risk.

note.en: Consensus is +55,000 jobs with unemployment at 4.2%.

title.en: EC sets Sarawak election dates

note.en: First three-way round since February; Zelenskiy hopes it leads to a Putin meeting.

title.en: Russia-Ukraine-US talks, Abu Dhabi (Nov 10-11)

note.en: Key test for BN and PH ahead of GE16.
