headline.bm: Demokrat menguasai kedua-dua dewan Kongres AS dan Trump menerima keputusan itu, mendorong emas melepasi $4,000 dan dolar ke paras terendah sebulan. Trump mengesahkan serangan ke atas tapak pertahanan udara Iran berhampiran Hormuz ketika Tehran menyifatkan jawapan AS 'tidak meyakinkan', dengan Brent melebihi $104, manakala Bank Negara memutuskan kadar faedah esok. Secara berasingan, Ebola di DR Congo telah melepasi 10,000 kes disahkan, dan Apple melancarkan lima Mac dan iPad baharu pada Jumaat. Google turut menumpaskan botnet 1.3 juta kotak TV Android yang menjejaskan Malaysia antara yang paling teruk.
headline.en: Democrats have taken both chambers of the US Congress and Trump has accepted the result, pushing gold above $4,000 and the dollar to a one-month low. Trump confirmed a strike on an Iranian air-defence site near Hormuz as Tehran called the US reply 'not convincing', with Brent above $104, while Bank Negara decides on rates tomorrow. Separately, Ebola in DR Congo has passed 10,000 confirmed cases, and Apple launches five new Macs and iPads on Friday. Google has also taken down a 1.3m-device Android TV-box botnet in which Malaysia is among the worst hit.

summary.bm: Google yakin tinggi pengeluar Shenzhen, Videostrong, sengaja membina pintu belakang dalam kotak TV Android dan menjual akses kepada penjenayah, lalu mengharamkan syarikat itu daripada peranti Android bersijil. TrendAI mengira kira-kira 1.47 juta peranti dijangkiti merentas 206 model, dengan Malaysia, Brazil, Iraq, Mexico dan Taiwan paling banyak; pintu belakang kekal pada kotak dan pemilik tidak boleh membuangnya sendiri.
summary.en: Google says it is highly confident Shenzhen maker Videostrong built a backdoor into its Android TV boxes and sold access to criminals, and has banned the firm from certified Android devices. TrendAI counted about 1.47m infected devices across 206 models, with Malaysia, Brazil, Iraq, Mexico and Taiwan the most infected; the backdoor stays on the boxes and owners cannot remove it themselves.

title.bm: Google tumpaskan botnet 1.3 juta peranti kotak TV Android; Malaysia antara paling terjejas
title.en: Google takes down a 1.3m-device Android TV-box botnet; Malaysia is among the worst hit

why.bm: Semak mana-mana kotak TV Android murah di rumah atau pejabat; tetap semula atau buang yang terjejas dan asingkan daripada rangkaian utama.
why.en: Check any cheap Android TV box at home or work; reset or discard affected ones and keep them off your main network.

summary.bm: Sekoia berkata APT29 menjalankan kempen 'watering hole' melalui laman yang digodam, domain tiruan dan skrip Plerdy SEO Tracker Ukraine (27 Ogos–3 Sept) untuk menghantar rantaian eksploit terhadap iOS lama (16.7, 18.5) dan Chrome 139–145 pada Android. Data yang dicuri termasuk kuki, mesej dan kata laluan Wi-Fi; sasaran kelihatan berkait dengan perang Rusia–Ukraine.
summary.en: Sekoia says APT29 ran a watering-hole campaign using compromised sites, lookalike domains and the Ukrainian Plerdy SEO Tracker script (Aug 27–Sep 3) to deliver exploit chains against older iOS (16.7, 18.5) and Chrome 139–145 on Android. Stolen data includes cookies, messages and Wi-Fi passwords; targets appear linked to the Russia–Ukraine war.

title.bm: APT29 yang dikaitkan dengan Rusia rampas skrip analitik web untuk serang iPhone dan telefon Android
title.en: Russia-linked APT29 hijacks a web analytics script to hit iPhones and Android phones

why.bm: Pastikan iOS dan Chrome dikemas kini sepenuhnya dan berhati-hati dengan pautan yang menyuruh anda tukar pelayar.
why.en: Keep iOS and Chrome fully updated and be wary of links that push you to switch browsers.

summary.bm: Diumumkan di satu majlis di Universiti Malaya yang dihadiri Anwar, jumlah itu tambahan kepada pelan terdahulu yang sama nilainya bagi 2027–2028. Google juga berjanji meningkatkan kemahiran 800,000 rakyat Malaysia dan menambah lebih 1GW tenaga bersih bersama Tenaga Nasional.
summary.en: Announced at a Universiti Malaya event attended by Anwar, the sum is on top of an earlier plan of the same size over 2027–2028. Google also pledged to upskill 800,000 Malaysians and to add over 1GW of clean energy with Tenaga Nasional.

title.bm: Google tambah AS$15 bilion (RM61 bilion) untuk AI dan awan Malaysia, dengan pusat data di Selangor dan Negeri Sembilan
title.en: Google adds US$15bn (RM61bn) for Malaysian AI and cloud, with data centres in Selangor and Negeri Sembilan

why.bm: Lebih banyak pekerjaan AI, program kemahiran dan permintaan pusat data di Malaysia, dengan tekanan tambahan pada bekalan elektrik.
why.en: More AI jobs, skills programmes and data-centre demand for Malaysia, with extra pressure on grid power.

summary.bm: Trump memberitahu Fox bahawa AS menyerang kemudahan antipesawat awal Selasa, menyifatkannya serangan kecil, bukan perang; media Iran menamakan Pulau Qeshm. Iran berkata Hormuz akan dibuka semula dalam dua hari hanya jika AS memenuhi tujuh tuntutan, termasuk menarik sekatan dan kepungan laut, dan Qatar berkata rundingan diteruskan. Media AS melaporkan rancangan serangan seawal Rabu dengan tiga kapal pengangkut di rantau itu. Secara berasingan, UKMTO berkata projektil mengenai kapal tangki di luar Oman, IRGC mendakwa empat kapal tangki terkena periuk api, belum disahkan, dan China meningkatkan diplomasi Iran.
summary.en: Trump told Fox the US hit an anti-aircraft facility early Tuesday, calling it a minor attack, not war; Iranian media named Qeshm Island. Iran says Hormuz would reopen over two days only if the US meets seven demands, including lifting sanctions and the blockade, and Qatar says talks continue. US media report strike plans from as early as Wednesday with three carriers in the region. Separately, UKMTO says projectiles hit a tanker off Oman, the IRGC claims four tankers hit mines, unverified, and China is stepping up Iran diplomacy.

title.bm: Trump sahkan serangan ke atas tapak pertahanan udara Qeshm, Tehran kata jawapan AS 'tidak meyakinkan'
title.en: Trump confirms a strike on Iran's Qeshm air-defence site as Tehran calls the US reply 'not convincing'

why.bm: Hormuz ialah pemacu utama kos minyak dan bahan api; harga pam tanpa subsidi di Malaysia sudah meningkat, dan pusingan serangan baharu akan menaikkannya lagi.
why.en: Hormuz is the main driver of oil and fuel costs; unsubsidised pump prices in Malaysia are already rising, and a new strike round would push them further.

summary.bm: Zelenskiy berkata sekurang-kurangnya 33 orang terbunuh, termasuk dua penyelamat dan empat polis, apabila Rusia menyerang sekolah yang dijadikan hab bantuan di Zaporizhzhia, dengan kira-kira 50 masih di bawah runtuhan; Moscow berkata ia menyasarkan unit tentera. Rundingan dengan pengantaraan AS ditetapkan di Abu Dhabi pada 10-11 Nov, disahkan Kremlin. FT melaporkan pegawai AS, Rusia dan China membincangkan pertemuan tiga pemimpin di APEC Shenzhen; Reuters tidak dapat mengesahkannya serta-merta.
summary.en: Zelenskiy says at least 33 people died, including two rescuers and four police, when Russia struck a school-turned-aid hub in Zaporizhzhia, with about 50 still under rubble; Moscow says it hit military units. US-mediated talks are set for Abu Dhabi on Nov 10-11, confirmed by the Kremlin. The FT says US, Russian and Chinese officials are discussing a three-way leaders' meeting at APEC in Shenzhen; Reuters could not immediately verify it.

title.bm: Korban di sekolah bantuan Ukraine meningkat kepada 33 ketika rundingan Abu Dhabi hampir, pertemuan Trump-Putin-Xi dibincang
title.en: Death toll at Ukrainian aid school reaches 33 as Abu Dhabi talks near and a Trump-Putin-Xi meeting is discussed

why.bm: Sidang tiga pihak akan mengubah landskap kuasa besar bagi Asia, dan sebarang kemajuan Ukraine boleh melegakan pasaran tenaga dan bijirin.
why.en: A three-way summit would reshape the big-power picture for Asia, and any Ukraine progress could ease energy and grain markets.

summary.bm: China berkata ia menghantar satu lagi rondaan pengawal pantai di luar pantai timur Taiwan, dan AP melaporkan pencerobohan ke-13 berhampiran Kepulauan Pratas tahun ini, melibatkan 16 kapal. Menteri Luar Filipina Lazaro dan Wang Yi menyifatkan perbualan telefon mereka membina, tetapi versi China menuduh Manila campur tangan berniat jahat. Manila, pengerusi ASEAN, menjadi tuan rumah sidang kemuncak lewat bulan ini.
summary.en: China says it sent another coast guard patrol off Taiwan's east coast, and AP reports the 13th intrusion near the Pratas Islands this year, involving 16 vessels. Philippine Foreign Minister Lazaro and Wang Yi both called their phone talks constructive, but China's account accused Manila of malicious interference. Manila, the ASEAN chair, hosts the summit later this month.

title.bm: Pengawal pantai China menekan Taiwan ketika Manila dan Beijing bertelagah tentang panggilan menjelang sidang ASEAN
title.en: China's coast guard presses Taiwan as Manila and Beijing clash over a call ahead of the ASEAN summit

why.bm: Ketegangan di perairan ini menyentuh tuntutan Malaysia sendiri di luar Sabah dan Sarawak, dan membayangi rundingan ASEAN dengan China.
why.en: Friction in these waters touches Malaysia's own claims off Sabah and Sarawak, and it hangs over ASEAN's talks with China.

summary.bm: Sudan mengemukakan aduan kepada Majlis Keselamatan PBB dan Kesatuan Afrika, mencatatkan 70 serangan dengan 187 dron yang didakwanya dilancarkan dari wilayah Ethiopia antara Februari dan Oktober, 97 daripadanya pada Oktober sahaja. Ia melaporkan 484 orang awam dan 176 askar terbunuh serta lebih 90% stesen janakuasa bandar lumpuh. Ethiopia menafikan menyokong RSF, dan penganalisis memberitahu Al Jazeera bahawa kebimbangan terhadap peningkatan konflik serantau setakat ini menghalang pertempuran terbuka.
summary.en: Sudan has complained to the UN Security Council and African Union, counting 70 assaults with 187 drones it says were launched from Ethiopian territory between February and October, 97 of them in October alone. It reports 484 civilians and 176 soldiers killed and over 90% of city power stations out of service. Ethiopia denies backing the RSF, and analysts told Al Jazeera that fear of regional escalation is so far preventing open conflict.

title.bm: Sudan bawa Ethiopia ke PBB atas serangan dron RSF, mencetuskan kebimbangan perang lebih luas
title.en: Sudan takes Ethiopia to the UN over RSF drone attacks, raising fears of a wider war

why.bm: Krisis pelarian melibatkan kira-kira 13 juta orang boleh merebak ke seluruh Tanduk Afrika, bersebelahan laluan perkapalan Laut Merah yang sama.
why.en: A displacement crisis of about 13 million people could spread across the Horn of Africa, next to the same Red Sea shipping routes.

summary.bm: Reuters, memetik empat sumber tentera, berkata kemaraan itu paling hampir sejak awal perang 2015 dan mengancam jalan antara Aden dan Taiz yang dikepung. Kerajaan yang diiktiraf melantik tiga menteri baharu pada 3 Nov. Ketua bantuan PBB Tom Fletcher berkata hampir 300,000 orang melarikan diri sejak Ogos, harga makanan di Taiz naik sekurang-kurangnya 50%, dan 70 kakitangan PBB masih ditahan.
summary.en: Reuters, citing four military sources, says the advance is the closest since early in the 2015 war and threatens the road between Aden and besieged Taiz. The recognised government named three new ministers on Nov 3. UN aid chief Tom Fletcher says nearly 300,000 have fled since August, Taiz food prices are up at least 50%, and 70 UN staff remain detained.

title.bm: Houthi dalam jarak 80km dari Aden ketika Yaman rombak kabinet dan hampir 300,000 hilang tempat tinggal
title.en: Houthis within 80km of Aden as Yemen reshuffles its cabinet and nearly 300,000 are displaced

why.bm: Penguasaan berhampiran Bab al-Mandeb mengancam perkapalan Laut Merah, sekali gus menjejaskan perdagangan dan kos pengangkutan Malaysia selain Hormuz.
why.en: Control near Bab al-Mandeb puts Red Sea shipping at risk, which matters for Malaysian trade and freight costs alongside Hormuz.

summary.bm: Presidium jawatankuasa pilihan raya meluluskan keputusan 27 Okt melalui undi pemutus, dengan Likud dan Shas berkecuali, selepas menyemak 9,069 pusat mengundi dan tidak menemui penyelewengan. Shin Bet berkata operasi pengaruh yang disyaki dibiayai asing mungkin melibatkan ribuan orang, yang dipersoal sumber polis, dan Ben Gvir menyifatkan undian itu dicuri. Keputusan dihantar kepada Presiden Herzog, dengan blok Netanyahu 53 kerusi berbanding 48 pembangkang. Trump berkata bantuan ketenteraan tahunan AS kira-kira $4 bilion tamat tahun ini, yang belum disahkan pegawai Israel.
summary.en: The election committee presidium approved the Oct 27 results on a casting vote, with Likud and Shas abstaining, after reviewing 9,069 polling stations and finding no irregularities. Shin Bet says suspected foreign-funded influence operations may involve thousands, which police sources question, and Ben Gvir calls the vote stolen. Results go to President Herzog, with Netanyahu's bloc on 53 seats against 48 for the opposition. Trump says the roughly $4bn in annual US military aid ends this year, which Israeli officials have not confirmed.

title.bm: Israel sahkan keputusan pilihan raya di tengah pertikaian dakwaan Shin Bet; Herzog akan pilih calon PM
title.en: Israel certifies election results amid a row over Shin Bet claims; Herzog next picks a PM candidate

why.bm: Kerajaan Israel seterusnya akan menentukan hala tuju Gaza dan Lubnan, isu penting dasar luar dan politik domestik Malaysia.
why.en: Israel's next government will decide what happens in Gaza and Lebanon, key issues in Malaysia's foreign policy and domestic politics.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan serangan Israel membunuh sekurang-kurangnya tiga orang di Gaza pada Isnin, dengan pegawai kesihatan mencatatkan sekurang-kurangnya 1,580 rakyat Palestin terbunuh sejak gencatan senjata bermula. Rundingan tersekat tentang pelucutan senjata Hamas dan pengunduran Israel, dan Israel menguasai kira-kira dua pertiga wilayah itu. Di Lubnan, Maariv melaporkan rancangan Israel yang mungkin menduduki Tyre, Sidon dan Nabatieh jika Hizbullah menyertai perang Iran yang bersambung semula, dan sumber menteri Lubnan berkata perang baharu tidak boleh diketepikan.
summary.en: Reuters reports Israeli strikes killed at least three in Gaza on Monday, with health officials counting at least 1,580 Palestinians killed since the ceasefire began. Talks are stuck on Hamas disarmament and Israeli withdrawal, and Israel controls about two-thirds of the territory. In Lebanon, Maariv reported Israeli plans to possibly occupy Tyre, Sidon and Nabatieh if Hezbollah joins a renewed Iran war, and Lebanese ministerial sources say another war cannot be ruled out.

title.bm: Serangan Israel di Gaza semakin kerap ketika gencatan senjata setahun buntu; Lubnan bimbang perang baharu jika pertempuran Iran bersambung
title.en: Israeli strikes intensify in Gaza as year-old truce stalls; Lebanon fears a new war if Iran fighting resumes

why.bm: Gaza kekal teras dasar luar Malaysia, dan Anwar menyebut pendirian tentang Palestin sebagai antara sebab Malaysia boleh berdepan serangan siber.
why.en: Gaza remains central to Malaysian foreign policy, and Anwar cited Palestine as one reason Malaysia could face cyberattacks.

summary.bm: Demokrat memenangi majoriti di Senat dan Dewan Perwakilan, dan Reuters melaporkan Trump telah menerima keputusan itu. Abdul El-Sayed menewaskan Mike Rogers di Michigan dan, jika disahkan, akan menjadi senator AS Muslim pertama, manakala Jon Ossoff mengekalkan Georgia. Hakeem Jeffries dijangka menjadi Speaker Dewan berkulit hitam yang pertama, dan Kongres baharu mengambil alih pada Januari. Trump berkata beliau boleh memveto rang undang-undang Demokrat dan akan memilih perang dengan Iran sekali lagi.
summary.en: Democrats won majorities in the Senate and House, and Reuters reports Trump has accepted the results. Abdul El-Sayed beat Mike Rogers in Michigan and, if confirmed, would be the first Muslim US senator, while Jon Ossoff held Georgia. Hakeem Jeffries is poised to be the first Black House Speaker, with the new Congress taking over in January. Trump says he could veto Democratic bills and would again choose war with Iran.

title.bm: Demokrat menguasai kedua-dua dewan Kongres, Trump terima keputusan dan salahkan namanya tiada dalam kertas undi
title.en: Democrats take both chambers of Congress as Trump accepts the result and blames his absence from the ballot

why.bm: Kongres dikuasai Demokrat boleh menyekat agenda Trump dan menekan beliau tentang tarif, perbelanjaan dan perang Iran, yang semuanya memberi kesan kepada perdagangan, kos bahan api dan pasaran Malaysia.
why.en: A Democratic Congress can block Trump's agenda and press him on tariffs, spending and the Iran war, all of which feed into Malaysian trade, fuel costs and markets.

summary.bm: Harga emas spot melonjak 2.4% kepada $4,021.68 ketika dolar jatuh ke paras terendah sebulan. STOXX 600 naik 0.5% selepas niaga hadapan jatuh sehingga 1.4%, dengan saham bank naik lebih 2% dan Orsted naik 7%, manakala unjuran AMD mengangkat sektor teknologi 0.4%. Asia lebih teruk, dengan The National melaporkan Nikkei turun kira-kira 3.5% akibat jualan saham berkaitan AI selepas kemenangan Demokrat menimbulkan kebimbangan peraturan.
summary.en: Spot gold jumped 2.4% to $4,021.68 as the dollar slid to a one-month low. The STOXX 600 rose 0.5% after futures fell as much as 1.4%, with banks up over 2% and Orsted up 7%, while AMD's forecast lifted tech 0.4%. Asia was rougher, with the National reporting the Nikkei down about 3.5% in AI-linked selling after Democrats' wins raised regulation fears.

title.bm: Emas melepasi $4,000 dan dolar jatuh ke paras terendah sebulan; Eropah tidak terjejas, saham bank dan tenaga bersih melonjak
title.en: Gold tops $4,000 and the dollar hits a one-month low; Europe shrugs off the sweep as banks and clean energy rally

why.bm: Dolar yang lemah menyokong ringgit dan mengangkat emas, tetapi jualan berterusan saham AI akan menjejaskan saham cip dan pusat data Malaysia.
why.en: A weaker dollar supports the ringgit and lifts gold, but a sustained AI sell-off would hit Malaysia's chip and data-centre plays.

summary.bm: PMI pembuatan rasmi China turun kepada 49.3 pada Oktober daripada 50.1, kembali menguncup, dan PMI bukan pembuatan menyusut kepada 49.7, manakala tolok swasta RatingDog kekal 52.0. CSI 300 jatuh 8.5% pada Oktober selepas rekod 12 minggu berturut-turut kerugian. Mulai 2 Nov PBOC melaksanakan repo berbalik semalaman harian pada 1.25%, dan Cailian melaporkan pengawal selia akan membincangkan sokongan pasaran saham, tanpa pengesahan rasmi.
summary.en: China's official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 in October from 50.1, back in contraction, and the non-manufacturing PMI slipped to 49.7, while the private RatingDog gauge held at 52.0. The CSI 300 fell 8.5% in October after a record 12 straight weekly losses. From Nov 2 the PBOC is running daily overnight reverse repos at 1.25%, and Cailian reported regulators would discuss stock support, with no official confirmation.

title.bm: Aktiviti kilang China menguncup semula dan saham memasuki pasaran menurun ketika PBOC beralih kepada kadar semalaman
title.en: China's factory activity shrinks again and stocks enter a bear market as the PBOC shifts toward an overnight rate

why.bm: China rakan dagang terbesar Malaysia, jadi permintaan yang lemah di sana memberi kesan kepada eksport, minyak sawit dan harga komoditi.
why.en: China is Malaysia's largest trading partner, so weaker demand there matters for exports, palm oil and commodity prices.

summary.bm: Washington telah menggugurkan beberapa tuntutan, termasuk kuasa veto AS terhadap perjanjian dagang Kanada dengan negara lain. Duti AS yang diugut akan menjejaskan hampir $28 bilion barangan Kanada, dan Perdana Menteri Mark Carney berkata isu utama masih belum selesai.
summary.en: Washington has dropped some demands, including a US veto over Canada's trade deals with other countries. Threatened US duties would affect nearly $28bn of Canadian goods, and Prime Minister Mark Carney says the main issues are still open.

title.bm: Trump kata perjanjian dagang dengan Kanada hampir tercapai, tetapi Carney kata isu utama belum selesai
title.en: Trump says a Canada trade deal is close, but Carney says key issues are unresolved

why.bm: Sejauh mana Washington berkompromi menunjukkan apa yang boleh dijangka rakan dagang lain, termasuk Malaysia, daripada Trump yang kini lebih lemah.
why.en: How far Washington bends here shows what other trade partners, Malaysia included, can expect from a weakened Trump.

summary.bm: Oscar Puente meletak jawatan enam hari selepas perlanggaran berhampiran Urda, kemalangan serius kedua dalam tempoh setahun, dan menarik diri daripada senarai calon pilihan raya umum awal Sepanyol pada 29 Nov. Laporan terdahulu menyatakan beliau enggan berundur walaupun berdepan protes.
summary.en: Oscar Puente resigned six days after the collision near Urda, the second serious accident within a year, and withdrew from candidate lists for Spain's Nov 29 early general election. Earlier reports said he had refused to go despite protests.

title.bm: Menteri pengangkutan Sepanyol letak jawatan selepas nahas kereta api laju meragut sekurang-kurangnya 69 nyawa
title.en: Spain's transport minister quits days after a high-speed rail crash killed at least 69

why.bm: Bencana kereta api besar kini mempengaruhi pilihan raya Eropah, dan ia peringatan tentang tuntutan keselamatan kereta api laju ketika Malaysia merancang projek relnya sendiri.
why.en: A major rail disaster is now reshaping a European election, and it is a reminder of what high-speed rail safety demands as Malaysia plans its own rail projects.

summary.bm: AFP melaporkan taufan di pantai tenggara India meragut sekurang-kurangnya tiga nyawa dan mencetuskan hampir 100,000 pemindahan, kemarau Bolivia membunuh lebih 75,000 lembu, dan Chile mencatat Oktober paling hujan. Bank Dunia menjangka harga makanan naik 18% antara 2025 dan 2027, dengan padi di Asia antara tanaman berisiko.
summary.en: AFP reports a cyclone on India's southeast coast killed at least three and led to nearly 100,000 evacuations, Bolivia's drought has killed more than 75,000 cattle, and Chile had its rainiest October on record. The World Bank expects food prices to rise 18% between 2025 and 2027, with rice in Asia among the crops at risk.

title.bm: El Nino landa beberapa benua ketika Bank Dunia jangka harga makanan naik 18% menjelang 2027
title.en: El Nino hits several continents as the World Bank sees food prices rising 18% by 2027

why.bm: Beras dan makanan asas penting kepada kos isi rumah Malaysia; kenaikan harga global boleh menolak inflasi makanan tempatan.
why.en: Rice and other staples are central to Malaysian household costs; higher global prices can feed into local food inflation.

summary.bm: Bank pusat Australia menaikkan kadar tunai 25 mata asas kepada 4.85% melalui undian 6-3, kenaikan kelima tahun ini, dengan alasan inflasi yang meluas dan permintaan pelaburan didorong AI. Bank of England dijangka mula menaikkan kadar pada Khamis, dan Riksbank Sweden dijangka bergerak ke 2.00% hari ini. CME FedWatch menunjukkan peluang 78% Fed menaikkan kadar pada Disember, menurut Reuters.
summary.en: Australia's central bank raised its cash rate 25bp to 4.85% in a 6-3 vote, its fifth hike this year, citing broadly based inflation and AI-driven investment demand. The Bank of England is expected to start hiking on Thursday, and Sweden's Riksbank is expected to move to 2.00% today. CME FedWatch showed a 78% chance of a Fed rate hike in December, per Reuters.

title.bm: Kenaikan kadar merebak: RBA naikkan kepada 4.85%, Bank of England dijangka menyusul dan pasaran bertaruh Fed naikkan kadar Disember
title.en: Rate hikes spread: RBA lifts to 4.85%, Bank of England expected to follow as markets bet on a December Fed hike

why.bm: Kitaran pengetatan global menambah tekanan terhadap Bank Negara dan kos pinjaman rakyat Malaysia.
why.en: A global tightening cycle raises pressure on Bank Negara and on borrowing costs for Malaysians.

summary.bm: Ketua Setiausaha Negara Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar mengarahkan kementerian dan agensi menyemak pelan kesinambungan perniagaan supaya perkhidmatan penting terus berjalan jika infrastruktur kritikal terganggu, memetik ancaman dalam talian, sabotaj, disinformasi dan gangguan rantaian bekalan. Ini menyusuli kenyataan Anwar di Parlimen dan mesyuarat Majlis Keselamatan Negara pada 2 Nov. Zahid berkata stok makanan mencukupi sekurang-kurangnya enam bulan dan menggesa orang ramai tidak panik membeli.
summary.en: Chief Secretary Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar ordered ministries and agencies to review business continuity plans so essential services survive disruption to critical infrastructure, citing online threats, sabotage, disinformation and supply-chain shocks. It follows Anwar's Parliament statement and a National Security Council meeting on Nov 2. Zahid says food reserves cover at least six months and urged no panic-buying.

title.bm: Semua kementerian diarah semak pelan kesinambungan ketika Anwar beri amaran ancaman siber; bank dan pegawai berjaga-jaga
title.en: All ministries told to review continuity plans as Anwar warns of cyber threats; banks and officials on alert

why.bm: Pasukan IT dan rangkaian dalam kerajaan dan sektor kritikal perlu bersedia untuk audit dan latihan; pengguna biasa perlu berwaspada terhadap penipuan berkaitan gangguan.
why.en: IT and network teams in government and critical sectors should expect audits and drills soon; ordinary users should watch for disruption scams.

summary.bm: OPR dijangka kekal 2.75% esok, dengan firma penyelidikan menjangka tiada perubahan hingga 2027, walaupun UOB meramalkan kenaikan. Ringgit ditutup pada 4.0610 dan FBM KLCI pada 1,616.56 (-0.32%) akibat ambil untung saham bank dan telko.
summary.en: The OPR is expected to hold at 2.75% tomorrow, with research houses seeing it unchanged through 2027, though UOB has called a hike. The ringgit closed at 4.0610 and the FBM KLCI at 1,616.56 (-0.32%) on profit-taking in banks and telcos.

title.bm: Bank Negara putuskan OPR esok; Malaysia catat spread terendah rekod bagi sukuk dolar
title.en: Bank Negara decides on the OPR tomorrow; Malaysia wins a record-low spread on its dollar sukuk

why.bm: Kenaikan kadar akan menambah bayaran pinjaman bulanan, manakala harga sukuk menunjukkan pelabur asing kekal yakin dengan kredit Malaysia.
why.en: A hike would raise monthly loan repayments, while the sukuk pricing shows foreign investors remain confident in Malaysia's credit.

summary.bm: PH bertanding 24 daripada 28 kerusi Melaka dan Bersatu tujuh, dengan tiga pertembungan, selepas enam Ahli Parlimen Bersatu termasuk Muhyiddin menandatangani perjanjian keyakinan pada 29 Okt; penganalisis berkata bantahan DAP menjelaskan sikap berhati-hati ini. Manifesto PH menawarkan pelanjutan pajakan awal dan 30% kontrak kerja majlis tempatan untuk usahawan muda. Pengundian pada 14 Nov, dan SPR bermesyuarat pada 6 Nov bagi menetapkan tarikh pilihan raya 82 kerusi Sarawak.
summary.en: PH is contesting 24 of Melaka's 28 seats and Bersatu seven, with three clashes, after six Bersatu MPs including Muhyiddin signed a confidence pact on Oct 29; analysts say DAP's opposition explains the low profile. PH's manifesto offers early lease extensions and 30% of council works contracts for young entrepreneurs. Polling is Nov 14, and the EC meets on Nov 6 to set dates for Sarawak's 82-seat election.

title.bm: PH dan Bersatu rahsiakan pakatan Melaka ketika PH lancar manifesto; tarikh Sarawak diumum Jumaat
title.en: PH and Bersatu keep their Melaka pact low-key as PH unveils its manifesto; Sarawak dates come Friday

why.bm: Dua pilihan raya ini ujian utama gabungan Anwar menjelang PRU16 dan sejauh mana seteru lama sanggup bekerjasama.
why.en: The twin polls are the main test of Anwar's coalition before GE16 and of how far old rivals will cooperate.

summary.bm: Muhammad Shafee Abdullah berkata beliau tidak menerima arahan tentang pembayaran. Denda mesti dijelaskan untuk mengaktifkan pengampunan bersyarat September, yang membenarkan tahanan rumah sehingga 23 Ogos 2028, dan Peguam Negara berkata tiada tarikh akhir tetap. Kutipan dana Umno belum mencapai sasaran. Najib turut merayu sabitan 1MDB yang membawa hukuman 15 tahun dan denda RM11.4 bilion.
summary.en: Muhammad Shafee Abdullah says he has no instructions on payment. The fine must be settled to activate September's conditional pardon, which allows house detention until Aug 23, 2028, and the Attorney General says there is no firm deadline. Umno's crowdfunding has not reached the target. Najib is separately appealing his 1MDB conviction, which carried 15 years and an RM11.4bn fine.

title.bm: Peguam nafi laporan denda RM50 juta Najib dibayar hari ini; beliau kekal di Kajang selagi belum dibayar
title.en: Najib's lawyer denies reports the RM50m fine will be paid today; he stays in Kajang until it is

why.bm: Kes ini kekal titik pertikaian antara Umno dan rakan kerajaannya menjelang pilihan raya negeri.
why.en: The case remains a live fault line between Umno and its government partners before the state polls.

summary.bm: Menteri Pertahanan Khaled Nordin memberitahu Dewan Rakyat Malaysia tidak terikat dengan gesaan membelanjakan 5% GNP, dengan berkata ia menguntungkan kuasa asing. Majalah Malaysian Defence menganggarkan perbelanjaan sekitar 1.0-1.1% keluaran negara, dan kementerian menerima RM21.7 bilion dalam Belanjawan 2026. Secara berasingan, Kementerian Kewangan berkata ia mahu meluaskan perdagangan mata wang tempatan melalui kerjasama BRICS.
summary.en: Defence Minister Khaled Nordin told the Dewan Rakyat that Malaysia has no obligation to follow calls to spend 5% of GNP, saying they serve foreign powers. Malaysian Defence magazine puts spending at about 1.0-1.1% of national output, and the ministry got RM21.7bn in Budget 2026. Separately, the Finance Ministry says it seeks wider local-currency trade through BRICS cooperation.

title.bm: Putrajaya tolak tekanan kuasa besar untuk naikkan belanja pertahanan, kekal berkecuali
title.en: Putrajaya rejects big-power pressure to raise defence spending, keeping to non-alignment

why.bm: Pendirian ini menunjukkan cara Malaysia mahu berada di tengah antara AS dan China ketika ketegangan Asia meningkat.
why.en: The stance signals how Malaysia plans to stay between the US and China while Asian tensions rise.

summary.bm: Rafizi Ramli memberi keterangan pada 3 Nov. Satu laporan berkaitan ucapan beliau di Selayang pada 20 Okt tentang 'mafia korporat' dan dakwaan bayaran RM9.5 juta, di bawah Seksyen 500 dan 505 Kanun Keseksaan; satu lagi, dari Mac, berkaitan pemilikan saham bekas ketua SPRM Azam Baki. Kementerian Dalam Negeri berkata suruhanjaya diraja boleh diadakan jika ada asas kukuh, dan Op Viking telah membekukan aset melebihi RM409 juta.
summary.en: Rafizi Ramli gave his statement on Nov 3. One report covers his Oct 20 Selayang speech on a 'corporate mafia' and an alleged RM9.5m payment, under Penal Code sections 500 and 505; another, from March, concerns former MACC chief Azam Baki's shareholding. The Home Ministry says a royal commission is possible with solid grounds, and Op Viking has frozen over RM409m in assets.

title.bm: Rafizi kata polis siasat beliau melalui dua laporan selepas disoal di Bukit Aman; RCI masih mungkin
title.en: Rafizi says police are probing him under two reports after Bukit Aman questioning; RCI remains possible

why.bm: Kes ini menguji sama ada dakwaan salah laku pasaran Malaysia disiasat sewajarnya, dan ia berlaku di tengah kempen Melaka.
why.en: The case tests whether Malaysia's market abuse allegations get a real inquiry, and it lands in the middle of the Melaka campaign.

summary.bm: Menteri Kewangan II Amir Hamzah berkata perintah geran khas RM1.5 bilion akan diwartakan sebelum hujung tahun, dengan RM600 juta sudah dibayar, manakala hak 40% di bawah Perlembagaan masih dirundingkan. Anwar sebelum ini memberitahu Parlimen RM8.3 bilion dibayar untuk kemajuan hanya 13% bagi kontrak paip 2016, dan penstrukturan semula RM5 bilion mengurangkan anggaran kerugian kepada RM3 bilion.
summary.en: Finance Minister II Amir Hamzah says the order for the RM1.5bn special grant will be gazetted by year-end, with RM600m already paid, while the 40% constitutional entitlement remains under negotiation. Anwar earlier told Parliament RM8.3bn was paid for only 13% progress on 2016 pipeline deals, and a RM5bn restructuring cuts the estimated loss to RM3bn.

title.bm: Baki geran RM900 juta Sabah menyusul selepas perintah hujung tahun, Anwar dedah kerugian paip RM9.4 bilion
title.en: Sabah's RM900m grant balance to follow a year-end order, as Anwar details the RM9.4bn pipeline losses

why.bm: Wang Sabah dan janji MA63 menjadi teras hubungan persekutuan-negeri serta kedudukan GRS dalam kerajaan.
why.en: Sabah's money and the MA63 promise are central to federal-state ties and to GRS's place in the government.

summary.bm: Timbalan Perdana Menteri Ahmad Zahid Hamidi berkata pada 3 Nov bahawa kenyataannya tentang penggantungan atau pembatalan Surat Setuju Terima projek luar bandar di Sabah dan Sarawak adalah benar dan beliau boleh menunjukkan arahan berkenaan. Ia susulan pertikaian di Dewan Rakyat pada 2 Nov apabila Ahli Parlimen Jelutong RSN Rayer menyifatkan kenyataan itu cubaan menyabotaj Kerajaan Madani.
summary.en: Deputy PM Ahmad Zahid Hamidi said on Nov 3 his remarks about suspended or cancelled Letters of Acceptance for rural projects in Sabah and Sarawak were factual and he can produce the instructions. This follows a Nov 2 Dewan Rakyat exchange in which Jelutong MP RSN Rayer called the remarks an attempt to sabotage the Madani Government.

title.bm: Zahid nafi cuba menyabotaj kerajaan berhubung projek luar bandar dibatalkan, kata ada dokumen
title.en: Zahid denies sabotaging the government over cancelled rural projects, says he has documents

why.bm: Pertelingkahan terbuka dalam kerajaan perpaduan mengenai dana luar bandar Sabah dan Sarawak menjejaskan kestabilan gabungan menjelang pilihan raya negeri.
why.en: Open friction inside the unity government over rural funding for Sabah and Sarawak matters for coalition stability ahead of state polls.

summary.bm: Climate Impact Lab Universiti Chicago menganggarkan 484,500 kematian berlebihan berkaitan haba di seluruh dunia sejak Jun dan sekitar 373,000 lagi dalam enam bulan akan datang. Di Peru, kebakaran berkaitan El Nino membunuh sekurang-kurangnya 12 orang dan membantu menyebarkan denggi.
summary.en: The University of Chicago's Climate Impact Lab estimates 484,500 excess heat-related deaths globally since June and about 373,000 more over the next six months. In Peru, El Nino-linked fires killed at least 12 and helped spread dengue.

title.bm: Kesan haba El Nino: dianggarkan 484,500 kematian berlebihan akibat haba sejak Jun, denggi merebak di Peru
title.en: El Nino heat toll: an estimated 484,500 excess heat deaths since June, with dengue spreading in Peru

why.bm: Minum air secukupnya, elak panas tengah hari dan buang takungan air bertakung di sekitar rumah untuk kurangkan pembiakan denggi, terutama musim tengkujuh.
why.en: Stay hydrated, avoid midday heat and clear stagnant water around the home to reduce dengue breeding, especially during the monsoon.

summary.bm: ECDC melaporkan 10,274 kes disahkan dan 4,992 kematian di DR Congo setakat 29 Okt, merentasi lapan wilayah dengan penularan komuniti berterusan. WHO berkata tiada vaksin diluluskan atau rawatan khusus, dan percubaan vaksin bermula di DRC pada 23 Okt.
summary.en: ECDC reports 10,274 confirmed cases and 4,992 deaths in DR Congo as of Oct 29, across eight provinces with community transmission continuing. WHO says no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists, and a vaccine trial began in DRC on Oct 23.

title.bm: Ebola (Bundibugyo) di DRC melepasi 10,000 kes disahkan dan hampir 5,000 kematian
title.en: Ebola (Bundibugyo) in DRC passes 10,000 confirmed cases and nearly 5,000 deaths

why.bm: Risiko kepada Malaysia rendah, tetapi pelancong ke Afrika Tengah/Timur perlu ikut nasihat kesihatan, elak kontak dengan orang sakit dan lapor demam selepas pulang. WHO menasihatkan agar tiada sekatan perjalanan atau perdagangan.
why.en: Risk to Malaysia is low, but travellers to Central/East Africa should follow health advisories, avoid contact with sick people and report fever after return. WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions.

summary.bm: Setakat 26 Okt Kenya melaporkan sembilan kes disahkan dan dua kematian, semuanya dikaitkan dengan kes pertama. Nigeria melaporkan satu kes pada 20 Okt (dipindahkan ke Switzerland, 62 kontak diawasi), manakala wabak di Uganda sudah berakhir; ECDC menilai kebarangkalian jangkitan sangat rendah bagi penduduk EU/EEA.
summary.en: As of Oct 26 Kenya reported nine confirmed cases and two deaths, all linked to the first case. Nigeria reported one case on Oct 20 (evacuated to Switzerland, 62 contacts followed), while Uganda's outbreak has ended; ECDC rates the likelihood of infection as very low for people living in the EU/EEA.

title.bm: Kes Ebola muncul di luar DRC: Kenya 9 kes, Nigeria dan Perancis satu setiap satu; ECDC nilai risiko EU rendah
title.en: Ebola cases appear outside DRC: Kenya has 9 cases, Nigeria and France one each; ECDC rates EU risk low

why.bm: Kes import menunjukkan kepentingan saringan lapangan terbang; sesiapa pulang dari kawasan terjejas dengan demam perlu segera mendapatkan rawatan dan memberitahu doktor sejarah perjalanan.
why.en: Imported cases show why airport screening matters; anyone returning from affected areas with fever should seek care early and tell the doctor their travel history.

summary.bm: Kementerian Komunikasi memberitahu Parlimen dakwaan itu akan dikendalikan di bawah Akta Komunikasi dan Multimedia serta Akta Keselamatan Dalam Talian. Laporan ancaman Anthropic pada September menyatakan sebuah firma berpangkalan di Istanbul, yang menafikannya, menggunakan Claude merancang rangkaian persona palsu dan memprofil kesemua 222 kerusi persekutuan; Anthropic berkata ia menutup akaun tersebut dan tidak melihat penglibatan bermakna. Kementerian tidak menyatakan sama ada Anthropic telah menjawab.
summary.en: The Communications Ministry told Parliament the claims will be handled under the Communications and Multimedia Act and Online Safety Act. Anthropic's September threat report said an Istanbul-based firm, which denies it, used Claude to plan fake persona networks and profile all 222 federal seats; Anthropic says it shut the accounts and saw no meaningful engagement. The ministry did not say whether Anthropic has replied.

title.bm: MCMC minta bukti daripada Anthropic tentang rancangan pengaruh guna Claude yang menyasarkan pengundi Malaysia
title.en: MCMC asks Anthropic for evidence on a Claude-aided influence plan aimed at Malaysian voters

why.bm: Ini ujian awal sejauh mana undang-undang Malaysia menjangkau penyalahgunaan AI di luar negara, ketika pilihan raya negeri berlangsung dan RUU Tadbir Urus AI sedang digubal.
why.en: It is an early test of how Malaysian law reaches AI misuse abroad, with state polls under way and an AI Governance Bill being drafted.

summary.bm: Google berkata Gemini 4 Carbon, model terkuatnya untuk kejuruteraan jangka panjang dan pertahanan siber, sedang diuji secara terhad dengan kerajaan AS dan pakar pertahanan dipercayai sebelum dikeluarkan lebih meluas. Penasihat Mahkamah Keadilan EU berkata jawapan Gemini mungkin melanggar hak penerbit jika ia memintas paywall atau menggunakan semula ungkapan yang boleh dikenali, walaupun latihan model dilindungi pengecualian perlombongan teks dan data; pendapat itu tidak mengikat. Google memaklumkan pelanggan AI Plus ($4.99 sebulan) bahawa model Pro ditarik mulai 13 Nov, tinggal Flash dan Flash-Lite.
summary.en: Google says Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest model for long-horizon engineering and cyber defence, is in limited testing with the US government and trusted defenders before wider release. An EU Court of Justice adviser said Gemini's answers may infringe publishers' rights if it bypasses paywalls or reuses recognisable expression, though training is covered by the text and data mining exception; the opinion is non-binding. Google is emailing AI Plus subscribers ($4.99 a month) that Pro models go from Nov 13, leaving Flash and Flash-Lite.

title.bm: Google uji Gemini 4 Carbon dengan kerajaan AS; penasihat mahkamah EU sebelahi penerbit, AI Plus hilang model Pro
title.en: Google tests Gemini 4 Carbon with US government; EU court adviser sides with publishers, and AI Plus loses Pro models

why.bm: Keputusan itu boleh mengubah cara chatbot menggunakan kandungan berita, dan pengguna Malaysia pada pelan murah AI Plus akan merasai penurunan yang nyata.
why.en: The ruling could reshape how chatbots use news content, and Malaysian users on the cheap AI Plus tier will notice a real downgrade.

summary.bm: Moonshot menjanjikan pemberat penuh keluarga model hampir 3 trilion parameter ini menjelang 4 Nov, tetapi tiada pelepasan yang disahkan ditemui setakat ini. Moonshot melaporkan 65.7% pada Terminal-Bench 4.0, berbanding 66.4% untuk Claude Opus 5.5 dan 58.2% untuk GPT-6 Astra, angka sendiri yang belum disahkan. Ia berkata bahan serangan siber dibuang daripada latihan, sekali gus menurunkan skor ujian eksploitasinya daripada 90.5% kepada 81%.
summary.en: Moonshot promised the full weights of the nearly 3-trillion-parameter family by Nov 4, but we found no confirmed release at the time of writing. Moonshot reports 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, against 66.4% for Claude Opus 5.5 and 58.2% for GPT-6 Astra, figures that are its own and unverified. It says it removed cyberattack material from training, which cut its exploit test score from 90.5% to 81%.

title.bm: Tarikh akhir pemberat terbuka Kimi K3.1 Pro tiba; belum ada pengesahan pelepasan
title.en: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro open-weights deadline is here; no confirmed release yet

why.bm: Pemberat terbuka yang hampir setaraf model termaju membolehkan syarikat menjalankan model kuat pada perkakasan sendiri tanpa bergantung pada API AS atau China, sesuatu yang penting bagi firma Malaysia yang sensitif tentang data.
why.en: Open weights near the frontier would let companies run a strong model on their own hardware rather than rely on US or Chinese hosted APIs, which matters for data-sensitive Malaysian firms.

summary.bm: TechCrunch berkata hasil Q3 meningkat daripada $11.5 bilion manakala pengkomputeran mencecah kira-kira $10 bilion, iaitu 58% hasil berbanding 48%, dan S-1 terpinda menyenaraikan kira-kira $895 bilion komitmen serta kerugian bersih $23.3 bilion. Anthropic turut mengeluarkan FlashProve, prototaip sumber terbuka yang membuktikan sesuatu jawapan datang daripada model yang dikomit tanpa mendedahkan pemberat.
summary.en: TechCrunch says Q3 revenue rose from $11.5bn while compute reached about $10bn, or 58% of revenue from 48%, and the amended S-1 lists about $895bn in commitments and a $23.3bn net loss. Anthropic also released FlashProve, an open-source prototype that proves a response came from a committed model without revealing the weights.

title.bm: Pemfailan Anthropic tunjuk hasil Q3 $17 bilion tetapi kos pengkomputeran kini 58% daripadanya, prototaip pengesahan dilancar
title.en: Anthropic's filing shows $17bn Q3 revenue but compute now eats 58% of it, as a verification prototype ships

why.bm: Angka IPO pembuat Claude menunjukkan bagaimana kos pengkomputeran menentukan harga AI bagi semua pengguna, dan menjadi petunjuk ekonomi sektor ini.
why.en: The Claude maker's IPO numbers show how compute costs drive AI pricing for every user, and they are a read on the sector's economics.

summary.bm: Jill Hazelbaker, presiden dan ketua hal ehwal korporat Uber, menyertai OpenAI dalam peranan hal ehwal korporat yang sama dan meninggalkan Uber pada 30 Nov, lapor Bloomberg. FT berkata OpenAI mengurangkan pusingannya kepada $20 bilion daripada $30 bilion pada penilaian $1.25 trilion. OpenAI turut menggabungkan tab Chat dan Work dalam aplikasi desktop ChatGPT, dan ChatGPT serta Codex akan berkongsi satu kumpulan penggunaan.
summary.en: Jill Hazelbaker, Uber's president and chief corporate affairs officer, joins OpenAI in the same corporate affairs role and leaves Uber on Nov 30, Bloomberg reports. The FT said OpenAI lowered its round to $20bn from $30bn at a $1.25tn valuation. OpenAI is also merging the Chat and Work tabs in the ChatGPT desktop app, and ChatGPT and Codex will draw on one usage pool.

title.bm: OpenAI ambil Hazelbaker dari Uber selepas kurangkan pusingan dana kepada $20 bilion; tab ChatGPT digabung, had dikongsi dengan Codex
title.en: OpenAI hires Uber's Hazelbaker after cutting its round to $20bn; ChatGPT tabs merge with shared Codex limits

why.bm: Pelabur semakin berhati-hati terhadap perbelanjaan AI ketika dua makmal utama menuju pasaran awam. Pelanggan berbayar ChatGPT yang turut menggunakan Codex mungkin lebih cepat mencapai had.
why.en: Investors are getting more cautious on AI spending just as both leading labs head for the public markets. Paid ChatGPT users who also use Codex may notice limits sooner.

summary.bm: Bloomberg melaporkan pasukan Harness DeepSeek melancarkan mod pencipta untuk membina pemalam dengan bahasa biasa dan pembantu pengekodan dipertingkat yang menyasarkan perkhidmatan seperti Anthropic, selepas mengumpul kira-kira 100 bilion yuan ($15 bilion) menjelang IPO yang dirancang. Ia juga menjadikan dsh-superagent sumber terbuka, prototaip penyelidikan yang menerima tugasan melalui sembang pasukan dan GitHub. KuCoin News, dalam laporan yang atribusinya tidak konsisten, menyatakan gangguan 3 Nov menjejaskan sembang serta API V4 Pro dan V4.1 Flash, insiden besar ke-19 pada 2026.
summary.en: Bloomberg reports DeepSeek's Harness team launched a creator mode for building plugins from plain English and an enhanced coding assistant aimed at services like Anthropic's, after raising about 100bn yuan ($15bn) ahead of a planned IPO. It also open-sourced dsh-superagent, a research prototype that takes work from team chat and GitHub. KuCoin News, in a report with inconsistent attribution, says a Nov 3 outage hit chat and the V4 Pro and V4.1 Flash APIs, its 19th major incident of 2026.

title.bm: DeepSeek ceburi ejen AI dengan mod pencipta dan ejen pengekodan sumber terbuka, tetapi alami gangguan lagi
title.en: DeepSeek pushes into AI agents with creator mode and an open-source coding agent, but suffers another outage

why.bm: Ejen China yang murah menambah persaingan alat pengekodan, namun gangguan berulang menunjukkan kekurangan kuasa pengkomputeran yang mengehadkan makmal China.
why.en: Cheap Chinese agents add competition for coding tools, but repeated outages show the compute shortage limiting Chinese labs.

summary.bm: AFP melaporkan sistem penyejukan terganggu di sekurang-kurangnya 11 negara, dengan Jerman dan Romania merekodkan insiden baharu pada 3 Nov dan pendakwa Belgium sedang menyiasat. Pesuruhjaya makanan EU Christophe Hansen menyifatkannya cubaan sengaja mengganggu rantaian makanan. Agensi siber Romania menyifatkan serangan itu separa amatur dan tidak mengesyaki negara tertentu, dan tiada kumpulan mengaku bertanggungjawab; peralatan Coop Sweden yang terjejas disambung melalui rangkaian 4G lama.
summary.en: AFP reports refrigeration systems disrupted in at least 11 countries, with Germany and Romania logging new incidents on Nov 3 and Belgian prosecutors investigating. EU food commissioner Christophe Hansen called it a deliberate attempt to disrupt the food chain. Romania's cyber agency called the attacks semi-amateurish and does not suspect a state, and no group has claimed them; Swedish Coop's affected kit was connected over older 4G networks.

title.bm: Serangan peti sejuk beku pasar raya merebak ke sekurang-kurangnya 11 negara Eropah; EU sifatkan serangan sengaja ke atas bekalan makanan
title.en: Supermarket freezer attacks spread to at least 11 European countries; EU calls it a deliberate hit on food supply

why.bm: Peralatan bangunan yang bersambung ke Internet ialah sasaran mudah bagi mana-mana pengendali, termasuk peruncit Malaysia dan pasukan IT yang menggunakan pautan selular lama.
why.en: Internet-connected building equipment is a soft target for any operator, including Malaysian retailers and IT teams running legacy cellular links.

summary.bm: Binance berkata perekrut palsu memperdaya jurutera dompet membuka tugasan pengekodan berniat jahat yang terlepas daripada alat keselamatannya, kemudian mencapai komputer dua lagi jurutera dan sistem yang mengawal berbilion dolar. FBI menyalahkan Korea Utara, yang menafikannya. Kira-kira 233 juta XRP keluar dari lima dompet dalam empat minit, Binance membekukan kira-kira $2.85 bilion dan akan membayar balik pelanggan, dan Reuters berkata pengguna mengeluarkan kira-kira $4.64 bilion selepas pengeluaran disambung semula. FBI menamakan kumpulan TraderTraitor yang sejajar dengan Korea Utara dan meletakkan kecurian itu pada kira-kira $6.43 bilion, dengan $2.85 bilion dibekukan di rantaian oleh Tether, Circle, Ripple dan lain-lain.
summary.en: Binance says fake recruiters got a wallet engineer to open a malicious coding task its security tools missed, then reached two more engineers' machines and systems controlling billions. The FBI blames North Korea, which denies it. About 233m XRP left five wallets in four minutes, Binance froze about $2.85bn and will reimburse customers, and Reuters says users withdrew about $4.64bn after withdrawals resumed. The FBI names the North Korea-aligned TraderTraitor group and puts the theft at about $6.43bn, with $2.85bn frozen on-chain by Tether, Circle, Ripple and others.

title.bm: Binance dedah bagaimana temu duga kerja palsu membawa kepada kecurian kripto rekod $6.3 bilion
title.en: Binance details how a fake job interview led to the record $6.3bn crypto theft

why.bm: Tawaran kerja palsu ialah risiko sebenar bagi pembangun dan kakitangan IT Malaysia, jadi anggap ujian pengekodan daripada perekrut sebagai fail tidak dipercayai.
why.en: Fake job offers are a real risk for Malaysian developers and IT staff, so treat coding tests from recruiters as untrusted files.

summary.bm: Amaran CSA Singapura menyatakan pintasan pengesahan dalam Cisco Identity Services Engine dan Passive Identity Connector (versi 3.1 hingga 3.5) membenarkan penyerang mencapai antara muka pengurusan web melalui permintaan API khas. Amaran dikeluarkan pada 21 Sep.
summary.en: Singapore's CSA alert says an authentication bypass in the Cisco Identity Services Engine and Passive Identity Connector (versions 3.1 to 3.5) lets an attacker reach the web management interface with a crafted API request. The alert was issued on Sept 21.

title.bm: Kelemahan Cisco ISE CVE-2026-76460 (CVSS 10.0) dilaporkan dieksploitasi secara aktif
title.en: Cisco ISE flaw CVE-2026-76460 (CVSS 10.0) reported as actively exploited

why.bm: Pasukan rangkaian: tampal ISE segera, hadkan akses pelan pengurusan dengan ACL, semak access.log untuk nama pengguna pelik pada setiap nod, dan pasang semula jika disyaki dikompromi.
why.en: Network teams: patch ISE immediately, restrict management-plane access with ACLs, review access.log for odd usernames on every node, and re-image if compromise is suspected.

summary.bm: MacRumors menyenaraikan iPad mini OLED dengan A20 Pro (dari AS$699), iMac M6 (AS$1,499), MacBook Pro 14 inci M6 (AS$1,999) serta MacBook Pro 14 dan 16 inci OLED skrin sentuh (dari AS$2,899 dan AS$3,399). Kebanyakan model tiba pada hari pelancaran.
summary.en: MacRumors lists an OLED iPad mini with A20 Pro (from US$699), an M6 iMac (US$1,499), an M6 14-inch MacBook Pro (US$1,999) and OLED touchscreen 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pros (from US$2,899 and US$3,399). Most models arrive on launch day.

title.bm: Apple lancar lima Mac dan iPad pada Jumaat 6 Nov, termasuk MacBook Pro skrin sentuh pertamanya
title.en: Apple launches five Macs and iPads on Friday Nov 6, including its first touchscreen MacBook Pro

why.bm: Harga Malaysia belum disahkan dalam sumber; bandingkan selepas Apple Malaysia menyenaraikan harga ringgit.
why.en: Malaysian pricing is not yet confirmed in the source; compare once Apple Malaysia lists ringgit prices.

summary.bm: Apple mengunjurkan margin kasar suku Disember 45-46% daripada 47.9%, sebahagiannya akibat kos Siri berkuasa AI, dan CEO John Ternus menyifatkan harga memori belum pernah berlaku. Ia akan mewajibkan penarafan 18+ bagi aplikasi yang mempunyai ciri janji temu atau romantik, dengan deskriptor baharu perlu mulai 16 Nov. Skyworks jatuh lebih 14% selepas waktu dagangan dengan unjuran $1.80-1.90 bilion berbanding jangkaan kira-kira $1.99 bilion, memetik permintaan Android premium yang lemah.
summary.en: Apple guided December-quarter gross margin to 45-46% from 47.9%, partly on AI-powered Siri costs, and CEO John Ternus called memory pricing unprecedented. It will require an 18+ rating for apps with dating or romantic features, with new descriptors due from Nov 16. Skyworks fell over 14% after hours on a $1.80-1.90bn forecast against about $1.99bn expected, citing soft premium Android demand.

title.bm: Apple beri amaran kos memori dan tetapkan peraturan 18+ untuk aplikasi janji temu dan teman AI; Skyworks jatuh akibat telefon lemah
title.en: Apple warns of memory costs and sets 18+ rules for dating and AI companion apps; Skyworks sinks on weak phones

why.bm: Permintaan AI terhadap memori menaikkan kos telefon dan komputer riba, jadi pembeli di Malaysia mungkin perlu membayar lebih.
why.en: AI demand for memory is pushing up the cost of phones and laptops, so everyday buyers in Malaysia may pay more.

summary.bm: MacRumors berkata beta pembangun pertama iOS 27.3 dijadual 3 Nov dengan keluaran awam pada Disember. Di China ia mengaktifkan Writing Tools, Genmoji dan Visual Intelligence pada iPhone 15 Pro ke atas, dengan Qwen Alibaba ditambah ke Siri.
summary.en: MacRumors says the first iOS 27.3 developer beta was due Nov 3 with a public release in December. In China it enables Writing Tools, Genmoji and Visual Intelligence on iPhone 15 Pro and newer, with Alibaba's Qwen added to Siri.

title.bm: Beta iOS 27.3 bermula; Apple Intelligence di China akan guna Qwen Alibaba
title.en: iOS 27.3 beta begins; Apple Intelligence in China will use Alibaba's Qwen

why.bm: Menunjukkan cara Apple menyesuaikan ciri AI dengan peraturan dan rakan tempatan; tiada perubahan untuk pengguna Malaysia daripada berita ini.
why.en: Shows how Apple adapts AI features to local rules and partners; no change for Malaysian users from this item.

summary.bm: MacRumors berkata iOS 27.2.1 ialah kemas kini kecil dengan pembaikan termasuk untuk iPhone Duo yang dilancarkan 23 Okt, tanpa tarikh keluaran lagi. Safari, Mail dan aplikasi yang guna rangka kerja rangkaian Apple sudah menolak sijil eMudhra yang dikompromi, dan macOS 27.2.1 mungkin memanjangkannya kepada alat baris arahan.
summary.en: MacRumors says iOS 27.2.1 is a minor update with fixes including for the iPhone Duo launched Oct 23, with no release date yet. Safari, Mail and apps using Apple's networking frameworks already reject the compromised eMudhra certificates, and a macOS 27.2.1 may extend this to command-line tools.

title.bm: iOS 27.2.1 sedang diuji; Apple sekat sijil eMudhra yang dikompromi sejak 19 Okt
title.en: iOS 27.2.1 under testing; Apple has blocked compromised eMudhra certificates since Oct 19

why.bm: Aktifkan kemas kini automatik iOS dan macOS supaya pembaikan sijil dan keselamatan sampai segera.
why.en: Keep iOS and macOS on automatic updates so certificate and security fixes arrive quickly.

summary.bm: Sammy Fans melaporkan Samsung kini menyediakan beta One UI 9.5, dengan Galaxy S26 mengetuai senarai pelancaran. Butiran lanjut selain tajuk itu tidak dapat disahkan dalam larian ini.
summary.en: Sammy Fans reports Samsung is now preparing the One UI 9.5 beta, with the Galaxy S26 leading the rollout list. Details beyond that headline could not be confirmed in this run.

title.bm: Samsung mulakan beta One UI 9.5, siri Galaxy S26 di barisan pertama
title.en: Samsung starts a One UI 9.5 beta, with the Galaxy S26 series first in line

why.bm: Perisian beta mungkin tidak stabil; tunggu keluaran stabil melainkan anda selesa menguji.
why.en: Beta software can be unstable; wait for the stable release unless you are comfortable testing.

summary.bm: Tampalan ini menggabungkan 155 pembaikan Google dan 24 pembaikan Samsung; 20 kritikal, 141 tinggi dan 15 sederhana, dan semua yang kritikal datang daripada Google. Pengeluaran bermula dalam beberapa hari, peranti baharu dan kelas atas dahulu.
summary.en: The patch bundles 155 Google fixes and 24 Samsung fixes; 20 are critical, 141 high and 15 moderate, and all critical ones come from Google. Rollout starts in the coming days, newer and higher-end devices first.

title.bm: Tampalan keselamatan November Samsung membaiki hampir 180 kelemahan, 20 kritikal
title.en: Samsung's November security patch fixes nearly 180 flaws, 20 of them critical

why.bm: Pemilik Galaxy patut memasang kemas kini sebaik ia muncul di Tetapan > Kemas kini perisian.
why.en: Galaxy owners should install the update as soon as it appears under Settings > Software update.

summary.bm: Google memulakan pelancaran Android 17 untuk peranti Pixel pada Jun 2026, menambah Gemini Intelligence, mod permainan untuk telefon lipat dan kawalan privasi lebih ketat, menurut The Next Web. Tiada keluaran Google/Android utama yang lebih baharu ditemui dalam larian ini.
summary.en: Google began the Android 17 rollout for Pixel devices in June 2026, adding Gemini Intelligence, a gaming mode for foldables and tighter privacy controls, according to The Next Web. No newer major Google/Android release was found this run.

title.bm: Terdahulu: Google lancar Android 17 untuk telefon Pixel dengan ciri Gemini, mod permainan lipat dan kawalan privasi
title.en: Earlier: Google rolled out Android 17 to Pixel phones with Gemini features, a foldable gaming mode and privacy controls

why.bm: Pemilik Pixel patut menggunakan Android 17 untuk perlindungan keselamatan terkini.
why.en: Pixel owners should be on Android 17 for the latest security protections.

summary.bm: Sumber Reuters berkata pegawai AS belum meluluskan lesen eksport peralatan yang dikehendaki SK Hynix untuk kilang Dalian, yang didakwanya akan membantu membiayai pengembangan di Amerika. Unit Solidigmnya merancang kira-kira $45 bilion untuk dua kilang NAND di Marcy, New York, dan berkata ia meneroka lokasi di seluruh dunia tanpa sebarang keputusan. Jabatan Perdagangan belum menolak secara rasmi lesen untuk mengisi ruang bersih yang kosong.
summary.en: Reuters sources say US officials have not approved export licences for equipment SK Hynix wants for its Dalian plant, which it argues would help fund expansion in America. Its Solidigm unit plans about $45bn for two NAND plants in Marcy, New York, and says it is exploring sites worldwide with no decision made. Commerce has not formally denied a licence for filling empty clean space.

title.bm: Rancangan cip SK Hynix bernilai $45 bilion di New York terjejas akibat sekatan AS terhadap kilangnya di China
title.en: SK Hynix's $45bn New York chip plan hits a snag over US curbs on its China plant

why.bm: Bekalan memori sudah ketat, dan sebarang perubahan lokasi pengeluaran NAND menjejaskan harga peranti serta rantaian bekalan cip yang turut melibatkan Malaysia.
why.en: Memory supply is already tight, and any shift in where NAND is built affects prices of devices and the chip supply chain Malaysia belongs to.

summary.bm: The Star melaporkan Meta mengutip AS$15 bilion dalam jualan bon AS lima bahagian pada 4 Nov. Secara berasingan, Skyworks jatuh kerana pasaran telefon pintar yang lembap membebani ramalannya.
summary.en: The Star reports Meta raised US$15 billion in a five-part US bond sale on Nov 4. Separately, Skyworks tumbled as a sluggish smartphone market weighed on its forecast.

title.bm: Meta kutip AS$15 bilion menerusi jualan bon AS lima bahagian
title.en: Meta raises US$15bn in a five-part US bond sale

why.bm: Menunjukkan skala pembiayaan di sebalik perbelanjaan AI syarikat teknologi besar dan pasaran cip telefon pintar yang lemah.
why.en: Shows the scale of financing behind big-tech AI spending and the soft smartphone chip market.

summary.bm: FT melaporkan Nvidia mengarahkan pelanggan awan menjual sekurang-kurangnya 51% perkhidmatan kepada syarikat bukan China, bagi kontrak akan datang sahaja. Crypto Briefing berkata pelanggan itu termasuk pengendali di Singapura, Malaysia dan Jepun, dengan pemeriksaan dan audit kontrak; tiada laporan Nvidia mengesahkan peraturan itu.
summary.en: The FT reports that Nvidia told cloud clients to sell at least 51% of their services to non-Chinese companies, for future contracts only. Crypto Briefing says the customers include operators in Singapore, Malaysia and Japan, with inspections and contract audits; Nvidia has not been reported as confirming the rule.

title.bm: Nvidia arah pelanggan awan jual 51% perkhidmatan di luar China; pengendali Asia dilaporkan terlibat
title.en: Nvidia tells cloud clients to sell 51% of services outside China; Asian operators reportedly in scope

why.bm: Jika peraturan ini terpakai kepada pengendali Malaysia, ia boleh mengubah siapa menyewa kapasiti pusat data di Johor.
why.en: If the rule reaches Malaysian operators, it could change who rents capacity in Johor's data centres.

summary.bm: Hasil Q3 AMD naik 45% kepada $13.4 bilion, jualan pusat data mencecah rekod $8.5 bilion, dan ia mengunjurkan Q4 kira-kira $17 bilion. Hasil Q1 fiskal Super Micro ialah $19.95 bilion, naik 298%, dengan unjuran Q2 $19.5-21.5 bilion dan unjuran fiskal 2027 dinaikkan kepada $72-82 bilion daripada $65-72 bilion. Unjuran AMD membantu menstabilkan saham teknologi Eropah selepas kejutan pilihan raya AS.
summary.en: AMD's Q3 revenue rose 45% to $13.4bn, data-centre sales hit a record $8.5bn, and it guided Q4 to about $17bn. Super Micro's fiscal Q1 revenue was $19.95bn, up 298%, with Q2 guidance of $19.5-21.5bn and its fiscal 2027 outlook raised to $72-82bn from $65-72bn. AMD's forecast helped steady European tech after the US election scare.

title.bm: AMD dan Super Micro melepasi jangkaan ketika permintaan pelayan AI melonjak; Super Micro naikkan unjuran setahun
title.en: AMD and Super Micro both beat as AI server demand surges; Super Micro lifts its full-year outlook

why.bm: Permintaan kuat cip AI menyokong eksport pembungkusan dan ujian cip Malaysia, yang memacu lonjakan 69% penghantaran ke AS tahun ini.
why.en: Strong AI chip demand supports Malaysia's chip packaging and test exports, which drove a 69% jump in shipments to the US this year.

summary.bm: Majoriti mengetepikan hukuman penjara 10 tahun dan tiga sebatan oleh Mahkamah Sesyen Shah Alam, kerana sabitan itu tidak selamat; seorang hakim menentang. Hakim Azman Abdullah mengingatkan beliau supaya tidak menyalahgunakan populariti.
summary.en: The majority set aside his 10-year jail term and three strokes of the cane from the Shah Alam Sessions Court, finding the conviction unsafe; one judge dissented. Justice Azman Abdullah warned him not to abuse his popularity.

title.bm: Mahkamah Rayuan bebaskan pendakwah Da'i Syed daripada tuduhan rogol secara 2-1
title.en: Court of Appeal frees preacher Da'i Syed of rape charge in a 2-1 decision

why.bm: Keputusan ini dibuat dalam kes yang bermula pada Disember 2020.
why.en: The ruling comes in a case that began in December 2020.

summary.bm: Sehingga Selasa petang, 575 orang daripada 253 keluarga terjejas di Kampung Melayu Subang, dan Anwar mengarahkan projek tebatan banjir Sungai Buloh dan Sungai Damansara bernilai hampir RM700 juta dipercepat. Selangor menyenaraikan 56 kawasan panas diketuai Klang, dan Johor 337 kawasan panas. Setakat 2 petang, 306 mangsa daripada 59 keluarga berada di tiga pusat pemindahan di Sungai Buloh, dan pembaikan tebing sungai berhampiran jambatan runtuh mungkin mengambil dua hingga tiga minggu.
summary.en: As of Tuesday afternoon, 575 people from 253 families were affected in Kampung Melayu Subang, and Anwar ordered the nearly RM700m Sungai Buloh and Sungai Damansara flood projects expedited. Selangor lists 56 hotspots led by Klang, and Johor 337 hotspots. As of 2pm, 306 people from 59 families were at three evacuation centres in Sungai Buloh, and riverbank repairs near the collapsed bridge may take two to three weeks.

title.bm: Banjir kilat melanda Lembah Klang lagi; Selangor dan Johor kenal pasti kawasan panas ketika monsun bermula
title.en: Flash floods hit the Klang Valley again; Selangor and Johor map hotspots as the monsoon sets in

why.bm: Semak InfoBanjir dan aplikasi myCuaca, dan elak memandu melalui jalan yang dinaiki air.
why.en: Check the InfoBanjir and myCuaca apps, and avoid driving through flooded roads.

summary.bm: Air banjir menutup NKVE di KM9.1 kedua-dua arah awal pagi 4 Nov dan menjejaskan persimpangan ELITE Shah Alam serta tanjakan GCE, walaupun air kemudian surut. Jambatan Jalan Kubu Gajah merentasi Sungai Subang runtuh kira-kira 2 pagi, dan JKR merancang jambatan Bailey sementara.
summary.en: Floodwater closed the NKVE at KM9.1 in both directions early on Nov 4 and hit the ELITE Shah Alam interchange and GCE ramps, though waters were receding later. A Jalan Kubu Gajah bridge over Sungai Subang collapsed at about 2am, and JKR plans a temporary Bailey bridge.

title.bm: Sebahagian NKVE, ELITE dan GCE ditutup akibat banjir; jambatan runtuh di daerah Petaling
title.en: NKVE, ELITE and GCE sections shut by floods; a bridge collapses in Petaling district

why.bm: Gunakan Jalan Merbau Sempak atau Jalan Paya Jaras Hilir sebagai ganti laluan Kubu Gajah yang ditutup.
why.en: Use Jalan Merbau Sempak or Jalan Paya Jaras Hilir instead of the closed Kubu Gajah link.

summary.bm: Pencen minimum kerajaan naik daripada RM1,000 kepada RM1,350 dan lebih sejuta pesara menerima RM750 sekali bayar. Pelepasan cukai individu naik daripada RM9,000 kepada RM12,000 mulai TY 2027 dan SARA sehingga RM150 sebulan dilanjutkan kepada semua penerima STR.
summary.en: Minimum government pension rises from RM1,000 to RM1,350 and over one million retirees get a one-off RM750. Individual tax relief rises from RM9,000 to RM12,000 from YA 2027 and SARA of up to RM150 a month extends to all STR recipients.

title.bm: Bajet 2027 untuk warga emas: pencen lebih tinggi, pelepasan cukai dan bantuan SARA
title.en: Budget 2027 for over-60s: higher pensions, tax relief and SARA aid

why.bm: Manfaat tunai dan cukai terus untuk pesara dan keluarga yang menjaga ibu bapa warga emas.
why.en: Direct cash and tax benefits for retirees and families caring for elderly parents.

summary.bm: Jawapan kementerian menyatakan 1,799 gagal penilaian kefahaman Program Transformasi Minda, sebahagian besar daripada 1,832 yang belum memenuhi kriteria antara 7,723 pegawai dalam proses pengesahan setakat 30 Sept. Fadhlina Sidek berkata kes tertunggak akan dipercepat bersama Suruhanjaya Perkhidmatan Pendidikan.
summary.en: A ministry reply says 1,799 failed the Mind Transformation Programme comprehension assessment, most of the 1,832 not meeting criteria among 7,723 officers undergoing confirmation at Sept 30. Fadhlina Sidek says pending cases will be sped up with the Education Service Commission.

title.bm: Hampir 1,800 guru percubaan tidak disahkan jawatan selepas gagal penilaian utama
title.en: Nearly 1,800 probationary teachers denied permanent posts after failing a key assessment

why.bm: Guru terlibat wajar menyemak status dengan jabatan pendidikan negeri masing-masing.
why.en: Affected teachers should check their status with their state education departments.

summary.bm: Kumpulan doktor itu berkata ia menentang keras sebarang pengecualian, sambil menyatakan Mahkamah Tinggi membatalkan pengecualian lalu pada Mei dan menteri pernah menyasarkan larangan seluruh negara pada 2026. Pihak berkuasa merampas 718.43kg produk vape disyaki mengandungi dadah dari 2023 hingga Jun 2026.
summary.en: The doctors' group says it strongly opposes any exemption, noting the High Court struck down the last one in May and that the minister had targeted a nationwide ban in 2026. Authorities seized 718.43kg of suspected drug-laced vape products from 2023 to June 2026.

title.bm: MMA tuntut penjelasan tentang laporan rancangan keluarkan nikotin vape daripada Senarai Racun
title.en: MMA demands clarity on a reported plan to take vape nicotine off the Poisons List

why.bm: Keputusan ini menentukan sama ada vape diharamkan atau makin diterima, terutama dalam kalangan remaja.
why.en: The decision will shape whether vapes are banned or further normalised, especially for young users.

summary.bm: Bagi 5-11 Nov, RON97 tanpa subsidi RM4.70 (-20 sen), RON95 RM4.27 (-15 sen) dan diesel RM5.12 (-15 sen). BUDI95 bersubsidi kekal RM1.99 dan BUDI Diesel RM2.10; kementerian memetik stok serantau yang lebih lembut dan Brent lebih rendah.
summary.en: For Nov 5-11, unsubsidised RON97 is RM4.70 (-20 sen), RON95 RM4.27 (-15 sen) and diesel RM5.12 (-15 sen). Subsidised BUDI95 stays at RM1.99 and BUDI Diesel at RM2.10; the ministry cites softer regional stocks and lower Brent.

title.bm: Harga pam turun mulai Khamis: RON95 turun 15 sen, RON97 turun 20 sen; BUDI95 kekal RM1.99
title.en: Pump prices fall from Thursday: RON95 down 15 sen, RON97 down 20 sen; BUDI95 stays at RM1.99

why.bm: Isian lebih murah bagi pemandu tanpa subsidi, walaupun kementerian memberi amaran ketegangan Asia Barat masih boleh menjejaskan kestabilan.
why.en: Cheaper fill-ups for non-subsidised drivers, though the ministry warns West Asia tensions still threaten stability.

summary.bm: Parlimen diberitahu kira-kira RM14 juta diperoleh semula sejak Pusat Respons Scam Kebangsaan bermula pada 2022, dengan 18,213 mangsa direkodkan dari 2016 hingga Ogos 2026, purata kira-kira RM67,500 seorang.
summary.en: Parliament heard about RM14m has been recovered since the National Scam Response Centre began in 2022, with 18,213 victims logged from 2016 to August 2026, averaging about RM67,500 each.

title.bm: Mangsa penipuan hanya mendapat semula kira-kira 1% daripada RM1.23 bilion yang hilang dalam sedekad
title.en: Scam victims have recovered about 1% of the RM1.23bn lost over a decade

why.bm: Bertindak dalam 24 jam pertama jika ditipu, dan semak akaun mencurigakan di SemakMule.
why.en: Act within the first 24 hours if you are scammed, and check suspect accounts on SemakMule.

summary.bm: Tahanan di Rawalpindi berada dalam keadaan sihat dan menerima makanan serta panduan undang-undang, menurut Parlimen, dengan 63 dari Sabah dan 55 dari Sarawak. Malaysia dan Pakistan sedang membincangkan tindakan susulan.
summary.en: The detainees in Rawalpindi are in good health and have received food and legal guidance, Parliament heard, with 63 from Sabah and 55 from Sarawak. Malaysia and Pakistan are discussing follow-up action.

title.bm: 130 rakyat Malaysia ditahan di Pakistan kerana disyaki penipuan dalam talian; kebanyakan dari Sabah dan Sarawak
title.en: 130 Malaysians held in Pakistan over suspected online fraud; most are from Sabah and Sarawak

why.bm: Berhati-hati dengan tawaran kerja luar negara yang meminta anda pergi untuk kerja dalam talian.
why.en: Be wary of overseas job offers that ask you to travel for online work.

summary.bm: The Edge berkata Mahkamah Persekutuan akan mendengar rayuan Ahli Parlimen Muar Syed Saddiq mengenai sama ada mahkamah boleh memutuskan perkara dasar, khususnya dana yang diperuntukkan untuk kawasan parlimen.
summary.en: The Edge says the Federal Court will hear Muar MP Syed Saddiq's appeal on whether courts can rule on policy matters, specifically funds earmarked for parliamentary constituencies.

title.bm: Mahkamah Persekutuan dengar rayuan Syed Saddiq mengenai dana kawasan pada 5 Nov
title.en: Federal Court hears Syed Saddiq appeal on constituency funds on Nov 5

why.bm: Keputusan boleh menjejaskan cara peruntukan kawasan dilayan di mahkamah.
why.en: The ruling could affect how constituency allocations are treated in court.

summary.bm: The Edge berkata bekas menteri sumber manusia M Saravanan telah memohon dibicarakan atas ketiga-tiga pertuduhan. Dokumen tambahan akan diserahkan dan tarikh perbicaraan ditetapkan.
summary.en: The Edge says former human resources minister M Saravanan has claimed trial on all three charges. Additional documents will be handed over and trial dates fixed.

title.bm: Kes rasuah Saravanan: dokumen diserahkan dan tarikh perbicaraan ditetapkan
title.en: Saravanan graft case: documents to be handed over and trial dates set

why.bm: Kes berprofil tinggi yang menjadi kepentingan negara bergerak ke arah perbicaraan.
why.en: A high-profile case of national interest moves toward trial.

summary.bm: Kementerian Kewangan berkata RM30 juta untuk terminal bas baharu di stesen Kota Bharu dan lebih RM200 juta untuk kerja awal sambungan Kota Bharu-Rantau Panjang, merangkumi reka bentuk, tinjauan dan kajian alam sekitar.
summary.en: The Finance Ministry says RM30m goes to a new bus terminal at the Kota Bharu station and over RM200m to preliminary work on a Kota Bharu-Rantau Panjang extension, covering design, surveys and environmental study.

title.bm: Lebih RM250 juta diluluskan untuk kerja ECRL di Kelantan, termasuk kajian sambungan Rantau Panjang
title.en: Over RM250m approved for ECRL work in Kelantan, including a Rantau Panjang extension study

why.bm: Sambungan lebih baik ke sempadan Thailand akan membantu perdagangan dan perjalanan di Kelantan.
why.en: A better link to the Thai border would help Kelantan trade and travel.

summary.en: Deputy Minister Marhamah Rosli told Parliament the Waqf, Zakat and Haj Department is assessing providers, and guidelines will go to the National Council for Islamic Religious Affairs before being published.

title.bm: Kerajaan kaji garis panduan perkhidmatan badal haji susulan iklan mengelirukan
title.en: Government studying guidelines for badal haj services after misleading ads

why.bm: Semak latar belakang penyedia dan butiran pembayaran sebelum membayar.

summary.en: Organisers apologised after the ministry cited a Safe Sport Code ban on alcohol sponsors. The Dec 10-13 event at Mitec is still awaiting its licence.

title.bm: Hyrox Kuala Lumpur gugurkan penajaan Carlsberg selepas kementerian sukan ugut batal permit
title.en: Hyrox Kuala Lumpur drops Carlsberg sponsorship after the sports ministry threatens its permit

why.bm: Pemegang tiket perlu menunggu keputusan lesen.
why.en: Ticket holders should watch for the licence decision.

summary.bm: Persembahan 4-5 Nov menamatkan jelajah yang bermula pada 2022 dan mengutip kira-kira AS$1.07 bilion, menurut Pollstar. Hujan mungkin turun dan penganjur menjangka trafik sesak.
summary.en: The Nov 4-5 shows end a tour that began in 2022 and has grossed about US$1.07bn, per Pollstar. Rain is possible and organisers expect heavy traffic.

title.bm: The Weeknd akhiri jelajah rekod dengan dua malam di Bukit Jalil, 130,000 peminat dijangka
title.en: The Weeknd closes his record tour with two Bukit Jalil nights, 130,000 fans expected

summary.en: Income tax refunds paid out reached RM20.27bn as of Oct 31, Parliament was told. Taxpayers still waiting can check their status with the Inland Revenue Board.

title.en: Government has paid RM20.27bn in income tax refunds as of Oct 31

why.en: Useful if your refund is still pending.

summary.en: Johor has identified 337 flood hotspots as it prepares for the northeast monsoon. Agencies are being readied for evacuations.

title.bm: Johor kenal pasti 337 lokasi panas banjir menjelang monsun timur laut
title.en: Johor flags 337 flood hotspots ahead of the northeast monsoon

why.en: Residents in low-lying Johor areas should prepare early.

summary.bm: Universiti Malaysia meningkat dalam kedudukan QS Asia 2027, dengan institusi swasta mendahului kenaikan.
summary.en: Malaysia's universities gained in the QS Asia 2027 rankings, with private institutions leading the gains.

title.en: Malaysia posts a record showing in QS Asia 2027, led by private universities
